आनन्द-उन्मद-नन्दि-पृष्ठ-ककुद-आरूढः | हरः | हासवान् || कैलासेन | समम् | समेतः | इव | यः | लिप्तः | सितैः | भस्माभिः || धन्यम् | धन्यम् | इति | ब्रुवद्भिः | अभितः | बृन्दारकैः | वन्दितः || निःशङ्कम् | वृषभ-अण्ड-पिण्ड-युगल-स्पन्दस्य | मन्द-इच्छुभिः ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

आनन्द-उन्मद-नन्दि-पृष्ठ-ककुद-आरूढः हासवान्, सितैः भस्माभिः लिप्तः यः हरः कैलासेन समं समेतः इव (बभौ). निःशङ्कम् वृषभ-अण्ड-पिण्ड-युगल-स्पन्दस्य मन्द-इच्छुभिः, 'धन्यं धन्यम्' इति ब्रुवद्भिः बृन्दारकैः अभितः वन्दितः.

Meaning of Terms
आनन्द-उन्मद-नन्दि-पृष्ठ-ककुद-आरूढः = mounted on the hump of Nandi, who is intoxicated with joy
हासवान् = smiling, laughing
सितैः भस्माभिः लिप्तः = smeared with white ashes
यः हरः = which Shiva
कैलासेन समं समेतः इव (बभौ) = shone as if he had arrived along with Mount Kailasa itself
निःशङ्कम् = without any hesitation
वृषभ-अण्ड-पिण्ड-युगल-स्पन्दस्य = of the throbbing pair of testicles of the bull (Nandi)
मन्द-इच्छुभिः = having a slight desire (to touch and tickle)
धन्यम् धन्यम् इति ब्रुवद्भिः = saying "Blessed art thou, blessed art thou"
बृन्दारकैः अभितः वन्दितः = worshipped on all sides by the gods
Meaning

Lord Shiva, mounted on the hump of Nandi, who was intoxicated with joy, was smiling. Smeared with white ashes, He shone as if He had arrived along with Mount Kailasa itself. He was worshipped on all sides by the gods, who, though having a slight desire to touch and tickle the throbbing testicles of the bull without any hesitation, nonetheless proclaimed, "Blessed art thou, blessed art thou!"

गङ्गोत्तुङ्गत रङ्ग कुन्तलचलद्-वाः शीकर क्षेपणैः
अम्भोयन्त्रकवक्त्रसूक्ष्मसुषिरै र्होली मिवक्रीडयन् ।।
वोढा योगिनिका-कदास्य विकृतैः सोढा स्व हासं हठात्
आयातः सुमवर्षणै रतितराम् छन्नो भवन वृक्षवत् ॥39॥
ambhoyantrakavaktra sūkṣmasuṣirai rholī mivakrīḍayan ।।
āyātaḥ sumavarṣaṇai ratitarām channo bhavan vṛkṣavat ॥39॥
gaṅgottuṅgataraṅga kuntalacalad-vāḥ śīkara kṣepaṇaiḥ
voḍhā yoginikā-kadāsya vikṛtaiḥ soḍhā sva hāsaṃ haṭhāt
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

गङ्गा-उत्तङ्ग-तरङ्ग-कुन्तल-चलत्-वाः-शीकर-क्षेपणैः || अम्भोः-यन्त्रक-वक्त्र-सूक्ष्म-सुषिरैः | होलीम | इव | क्रीडयन् || वोढा | योगिनिका-कदास्य-विकृतैः | सोढा | स्व-हासम् | हठात् || आयातः | सुम-वर्षणैः | अतीतराम | छन्नः | भवन | वृक्षवत् ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

गङ्गा-उत्तङ्ग-तरङ्ग-कुन्तल-चलत्-वाः-शीकर-क्षेपणैः अम्भोः-यन्त्रक-वक्त्र-सूक्ष्म-सुषिरैः होलीम क्रीडयन् इव, वोढा (शिवः) योगिनिका-कदास्य-विकृतैः हठात् स्व-हासम् सोढा (सन्) वृक्षवत् सुम-वर्षणैः अतीतराम छन्नः भवन आयातः.

Meaning of Terms
गङ्गा-उत्तङ्ग-तरङ्ग-कुन्तल = from the high waves of the Ganga in his matted locks
चलत्-वाः-शीकर-क्षेपणैः = by the scattering of moving water droplets
अम्भोः-यन्त्रक-वक्त्र-सूक्ष्म-सुषिरैः = through the fine apertures of the mouth of a water-spraying device (pichakari)
होलीम क्रीडयन् इव = as if playing the Holi festival
वोढा = the bridegroom (Shiva)
योगिनिका-कदास्य-विकृतैः = by the distorted facial expressions of the accompanying Yoginis
हठात् स्व-हासम् सोढा = having forcibly suppressed his own laughter
वृक्षवत् = like a tree
सुम-वर्षणैः अतीतराम छन्नः भवन = becoming completely covered by showers of flowers
आयातः = arrived, came
Meaning

The bridegroom, Lord Shiva, arrived as if playing the Holi festival, scattering water droplets from the high waves of the Ganga in his matted locks, like water being sprayed from the fine apertures of a pichakari. Having forcibly suppressed his laughter upon seeing the distorted facial expressions of the accompanying Yoginis, he came, completely covered by showers of flowers, like a tree.

माङ्गल्यय भजन्ति यं भवजनाः सोयं निजे मङ्गले
चर्माऽ धा नखदन्तकैरपियुतं सैंहं स्वकट्यां दृढम् ।।
मालां श्वेत सरोजपुञ्जरचितां कापालकान्तिप्रदाम्
लोकेभ्यो वरदो वरोऽवरवरै र्हास्योऽपि सन्नुर्वरः ॥40॥
carmā' dhā nakhadantakairapiyutaṃ saiṃhaṃ svakatyāṃ dṛḍham ।।
lokebhyo varado varo'varavarai rhāsyo'pi sannurvaraḥ ॥40॥
māṅgalyāya bhajanti yaṃ bhavajanāḥ soyaṃ nije maṅgale
mālāṃ śveta sarojapuñjaracitāṃ kāpālakāntipradām
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

माङ्गल्यय | भजन्ति | यम् | भव-जणाः | सः | अयम् | निजे | मङ्गले || चर्म | अधात् | नख-दन्तकैः | अपि | युतम् | सैंहम् | स्व-कट्याम् | दृढम् || मालाम् | श्वेत-सरोः-पुञ्ज-रचिताम् | कापाल-कान्ति-प्रदाम् || लोकेभ्यः | वर-दः | वरः | अवर-वरैः | हास्यः | अपि | सन् | उर्वरः ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

भव-जणाः माङ्गल्यय यम् भजन्ति, सः अयम् (शिवः) निजे मङ्गले नख-दन्तकैः अपि युतम् सैंहम् चर्म स्व-कट्याम् दृढम् अधात्. श्वेत-सरोः-पुञ्ज-रचिताम् कापाल-कान्ति-प्रदाम् मालाम् (च अधात्). लोकेभ्यः वर-दः वरः अवर-वरैः हास्यः अपि सन् उर्वरः (अस्ति).

Meaning of Terms
भव-जणाः = people of the world, worldly beings
माङ्गल्यय = for auspiciousness, for good fortune
यम् भजन्ति = whom they worship
सः अयम् = that very (Shiva)
निजे मङ्गले = in his own auspicious wedding ceremony
नख-दन्तकैः अपि युतम् = endowed with nails and teeth
सैंहम् चर्म = a lion's skin
स्व-कट्याम् दृढम् अधात् = firmly wore on his waist
श्वेत-सरोः-पुञ्ज-रचिताम् = though made of a cluster of white lotuses
कापाल-कान्ति-प्रदाम् मालाम् = a garland that gives the appearance (luster) of a garland of skulls (also wore)
लोकेभ्यः वर-दः वरः = this bridegroom, the giver of boons to the worlds
अवर-वरैः = by other bridegrooms of lesser status (ordinary bridegrooms of the world)
हास्यः अपि सन् = though he might be an object of ridicule
उर्वरः = is fruitful, or remains even at the time of dissolution
Meaning

Lord Shiva, whom the people of the world worship for auspiciousness, in His own sacred wedding ceremony, firmly wore a lion's skin, complete with its claws and teeth, around His waist. Though He wore a garland made of a cluster of white lotuses, it appeared to possess the luster of a garland of skulls. This divine bridegroom, the giver of boons to all beings, though He might be an object of ridicule to other, lesser bridegrooms of the world, is nonetheless the source of all fruitfulness and the One who endures even through the cosmic dissolution.

title: Kankaṇa Mocanam & Kanyādānam
html:
Kankaṇa Mocanam & Kanyādānam

The playful jests of relatives, Brahmā's description of Shiva's lineage, and the Kanyādāna ceremony.

Girīśa Girijā Pāṇigrahamu, Second Sarga (continuation) -

Kaṅkaṇa Mocanotsavaḥ:

लीलाफुङ्कृति-कृद्-भुजङ्ग-फणभृच्-छम्भोः करे कङ्कणः ।<br/>गौरी-कङ्कणगे मणौ निहितवान् बिम्बात्मनाऽहं परम् ।।<br/>मन्येऽहि र्मणिभृत्-फणीन्द्र-सविधै बाभाति तद्-बालभः ।<br/>जातः कङ्कण-मोचन-उत्सव-मिषान् मोको यथा सर्पयोः ॥41॥
Līlāphuṅkṛti-kṛd-bhujaṅga-phaṇabhṛc-chambhoḥ kare kaṅkaṇaḥ |<br/>Gaurī-kaṅkaṇage maṇau nihitavān bimbātmanā'haṃ param ||<br/>Manye'hi rmaṇibhṛt-phaṇīndra-savidhai bābhāti tad-bālabhaḥ |<br/>Jātaḥ kaṅkaṇa-mocana-utsava-miṣān moko yathā sarpayoḥ ||
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

लीला-फुङ्कृति-कृत्-भुजङ्ग-फण-भृत् | शम्भोः | करे | कङ्कणः | गौरी-कङ्कण-गे | मणौ | निहितवान् | बिम्ब-आत्मना | अहम् | परम् || मन्ये | अहिः | मणिभृत्-फणीन्द्र-सविधै | बाभाति | तत्-बाल-भः | जातः | कङ्कण-मोचन-उत्सव-मिषात् | मोकः | यथा | सर्पयोः ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

शम्भोः करे लीला-फुङ्कृति-कृत्-भुजङ्ग-फण-भृत् कङ्कणः, अहं बिम्ब-आत्मना गौरी-कङ्कण-गे मणौ परं (सर्पं) निहितवान्. मन्ये मणिभृत्-फणीन्द्र-सविधै (सः) अहिः तत्-बाल-भः बाभाति. कङ्कण-मोचन-उत्सव-मिषात् यथा सर्पयोः मोकः जातः.

Meaning of Terms
शम्भोः करे = in Shiva's hand
लीला-फुङ्कृति-कृत्-भुजङ्ग-फण-भृत् = bearing the hood of a serpent that hisses playfully
कङ्कणः = the bracelet (is there)
अहम् = (that serpent/bracelet) I
गौरी-कङ्कण-गे = situated in Gauri's bracelet
मणौ = in the gem
बिम्ब-आत्मना = through the form of my reflection
परम् (सर्पं) = another serpent
निहितवान् (इति मन्ये) = as if it placed, I think
मणिभृत्-फणीन्द्र-सविधै = near that king of serpents bearing a gem
तत्-बाल-भः = appearing like its offspring
अहिः = that serpent
बाभाति = shines
कङ्कण-मोचन-उत्सव-मिषात् = under the pretext of the festival of releasing the bracelets
यथा = just as
सर्पयोः (अपि) = for both serpents (also)
मोकः जातः = liberation (Moksha) occurred
Meaning

In Shiva's hand, there is a bracelet formed by the hood of a serpent that hisses playfully. It seems as if this serpent, through its reflection, has placed another serpent within the gem of Gauri's bracelet. This reflected serpent shines like the offspring of the gem-bearing king of serpents. It appears that under the pretext of the Kaṅkaṇa Mocana festival, both serpents have simultaneously attained liberation (Moksha).

वध्वा यद्यपि वेपथुः शिव-कर-स्पर्शेण नैसर्गिकः ।<br/>ऊचुस् तत्-परिचारिकाः सु-चतुरास् तद्-भाव-गोप-इच्छया ।।<br/>आः ! भौजङ्ग-भयाद् इवैजत करोऽस्या मुग्धता जन्मजा ।<br/>दास्यः सख्य-रसे मिलन्ति समये प्रेष्ठे प्रमत्ता हृदा ॥42॥
Vadhvā yadyapi vepathuḥ śiva-kara-sparśeṇa naisargikaḥ |<br/>Ūcus tat-paricārikāḥ su-caturās tad-bhāva-gopa-icchayā ||<br/>Āḥ ! Bhaujaṅga-bhayād ivaijata karo'syā mugdhatā janmajā |<br/>Dāsyaḥ sakhya-rase milanti samaye preṣṭhe pramattā hṛdā ||
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

वध्वाः | यद्यपि | वेपथुः | शिव-कर-स्पर्शेण | नैसर्गिकः | ऊचुः | तत्-परिचारिकाः | सु-चतुराः | तत्-भाव-गोप-इच्छया || आः ! | भौजङ्ग-भयात् | इव | ऐजत् | करः | अस्याः | मुग्धता | जन्मजा | दास्यः | सख्य-रसे | मिलन्ति | समये | प्रेष्ठे | प्रमत्ताः | हृदा ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

यद्यपि वध्वाः शिव-कर-स्पर्शेण वेपथुः नैसर्गिकः (तथापि) सु-चतुराः तत्-परिचारिकाः तत्-भाव-गोप-इच्छया ऊचुः - आः! अस्याः करः भौजङ्ग-भयात् इव ऐजत्, (अस्याः) मुग्धता जन्मजा. (यतः) प्रेष्ठे समये दास्यः (अपि) हृदा प्रमत्ताः (सत्यः) सख्य-रसे मिलन्ति.

Meaning of Terms
वध्वाः = of the bride, Pārvatī
शिव-कर-स्पर्शेण = by the touch of Shiva's hand
वेपथुः = trembling (shivering)
यद्यपि नैसर्गिकः = although natural
सु-चतुराः = very clever
तत्-परिचारिकाः = her female attendants
तत्-भाव-गोप-इच्छया = with the desire to conceal that emotion (of shyness/fear)
ऊचुः = they said
आः ! = Alas!
भौजङ्ग-भयात् इव = as if from fear of the serpent
अस्याः करः = her hand
ऐजत् = trembled
(अस्याः) मुग्धता जन्मजा = her innocence is inborn
यतः = because
प्रेष्ठे समये = at the most joyous (wedding) time
दास्यः (अपि) = even maidservants
हृदा प्रमत्ताः (सत्यः) = being intoxicated with joy in their hearts
सख्य-रसे मिलन्ति = mingle in the spirit of friendship (and jest)
Meaning

Although the trembling (shyness/fear) of the bride, Pārvatī, upon the touch of Shiva's hand was natural, her very clever female attendants, wishing to conceal this emotion, exclaimed: "Alas! Her hand trembled as if from fear of the serpent; her innocence is inborn!" For, at such a joyous wedding time, even maidservants, intoxicated with delight in their hearts, mingle in the spirit of friendship and engage in such playful jests.

Kanyā Dānotsavaḥ:

गौरी-शम्भु-विवाह-लग्न-समयेऽधिष्ट हासो महान् ।<br/>कन्या-तात-परम्परा तु गदिता शम्भोर् न सोक्ता यतः ।।<br/>ब्राह्मेऽस्मिन् नियमस् त्रिकं पितृ-भवं प्रोच्चार्यते त्रिर् मुहुः ।<br/>तत्-पूर्तिर् न यतो वरः पितृ-कथां शुश्राव नैव स्वयम् ॥43॥
Gaurī-śambhu-vivāha-lagna-samaye'dhiṣṭa hāso mahān |<br/>Kanyā-tāta-paramparā tu gaditā śambhor na soktā yataḥ ||<br/>Brāhme'smin niyamas trikaṃ pitṛ-bhavaṃ proccāryate trir muhuḥ |<br/>Tat-pūrtir na yato varaḥ pitṛ-kathāṃ śuśrāva naiva svayam ||
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

गौरी-शम्भु-विवाह-लग्न-समये | अधिष्ट | हासः | महान् | कन्या-तात-परम्परा | तु | गदिता | शम्भोः | न | सा | उक्ता | यतः || ब्राह्मे | अस्मिन् | नियमः | त्रिकम् | पितृ-भवम् | प्रोच्चार्यते | त्रिः | मुहुः | तत्-पूर्तिः | न | यतः | वरः | पितृ-कथाम् | शुश्राव | न | एव | स्वयम् ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

गौरी-शम्भु-विवाह-लग्न-समये महान् हासः अधिष्ट. यतः कन्या-तात-परम्परा तु गदिता, शम्भोः सा न उक्ता. अस्मिन् ब्राह्मे (विवाहे) मुहुः पितृ-भवं त्रिकं त्रिः प्रोच्चार्यते (इति) नियमः. यतः स्वयं वरः पितृ-कथां न एव शुश्राव (ततः) तत्-पूर्तिः न (अभूत्).

Meaning of Terms
गौरी-शम्भु-विवाह-लग्न-समये = at the auspicious moment of the marriage of Gauri and Shankara
महान् हासः अधिष्ट = great laughter arose
यतः = because
कन्या-तात-परम्परा तु गदिता = the lineage of the bride's father, grandfather, and great-grandfather was recited
शम्भोः सा न उक्ता = but that (lineage) was not spoken for Shiva
अस्मिन् ब्राह्मे (विवाहे) = in this Brāhma marriage
पितृ-भवं त्रिकं = the triad of father, grandfather, and great-grandfather
मुहुः त्रिः प्रोच्चार्यते (इति) नियमः = it is the rule to recite three times repeatedly
यतः = since
वरः स्वयम् = the groom (Shiva) himself
पितृ-कथाम् = the story of his father
न एव शुश्राव = had never heard
तत्-पूर्तिः न (अभूत्) = therefore, that ritual was not completed
Meaning

At the auspicious moment of the marriage of Gauri and Shankara, great laughter erupted. This was because, during the Kanyādāna, the lineage of the bride (Pārvatī) – her father, grandfather, and great-grandfather – was recited, but no such lineage was spoken for Shiva. In a Brāhma marriage, it is the sacred rule to recite the names of the father, grandfather, and great-grandfather of both the groom and the bride three times repeatedly. However, since the groom, Shiva, had never heard the story of his own father (as he is without origin), that ritual could not be completed.

Kā syāt tatra pitāmahasya ca kathā ? Kā tat-pitur vā kathā ? |<br/>Yo'nādir nakulo'thavā nigadito manye gurūṇām guruḥ ||<br/>Brahmaivātra sabhāsadaiḥ kṛta-paripraśnaḥ jagādottaram |<br/>'Dīrgha-dhvānaka'-vat tataiḥ prati-diśaṃ śrotṝṃś caturbhir mukhaiḥ ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

तत्र पितामहस्य च कथा का स्यात्? तत्-पितुः वा कथा का? यः अनादिः अकुलः (इति) निगदितः, (तं) गुरूणां गुरुः इति मन्ये. अत्र सभासदैः कृत-परिप्रश्नः ब्रह्मा एव प्रति-दिशं 'दीर्घ-ध्वानक'-वत् ततैः चतुर्भिः मुखैः श्रोतॄन् उत्तरं जगाद.

Meaning of Terms
तत्र = there (in Shiva's case)
पितामहस्य च कथा का स्यात्? = what story could there be of a grandfather?
तत्-पितुः वा कथा का? = or what story of his (grandfather's) father (great-grandfather)?
यः अनादिः अकुलः (इति) निगदितः = he who is declared as beginningless and without lineage
(तं) गुरूणां गुरुः इति मन्ये = him I consider the Guru of Gurus
अत्र सभासदैः कृत-परिप्रश्नः = to the question posed by the assembly members here
ब्रह्मा एव = Brahmā himself

For Shiva, who is without a father, what story could there be of a grandfather? And what story of his great-grandfather? He is indeed declared as beginningless (Anādi) and without lineage (Akula), and I consider him the Guru of all Gurus. When the assembly members posed this question, Brahmā himself, with his four mouths extended like 'loudspeakers' amplifying sound in every direction, provided the answer to the listeners.

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

लोकात् सकलात् प्राक् यत् शब्द-आत्मकं ब्रह्म प्रकटी बभूव. तत् पश्चात् यत्-अर्थ-पदतः तत् परंब्रह्म (इति) ख्यातम् अभवत्. तस्मात् शम्भु-शिव-आदि-शब्द-पटलम् पितृत्ववत् मन्यते. गङ्ग-उत्तुङ्ग-तरङ्ग-संघ-धृत्, भुजङ्ग-अन्वितः अयं (शिवः) पुत्रः (मन्यते).

Meaning of Terms
लोकात् सकलात् प्राक् = before the entire world came into being, in the very beginning
यत् शब्द-आत्मकं ब्रह्म = which Śabda-Brahman (the primordial sound, Omkara)
प्रकटी बभूव = became manifest
तत् पश्चात् = after that
यत्-अर्थ-पदतः = as the meaning of that sound
तत् परंब्रह्म (इति) ख्यातम् अभवत् = that Para-Brahman became manifest and renowned
तस्मात् = therefore
शम्भु-शिव-आदि-शब्द-पटलम् = the collection of words like Śambhu, Śiva, etc., which arose first
पितृत्ववत् मन्यते = should be considered as the father of Śiva
गङ्ग-उत्तुङ्ग-तरङ्ग-संघ-धृत् = bearing the high waves of the Gaṅgā river
भुजङ्ग-अन्वितः = adorned with serpents
अयं (शिवः) = this (Śiva in embodied form)
पुत्रः (मन्यते) = is considered like a son
Meaning

Before the entire cosmos came into being, in the primordial beginning, only the Śabda-Brahman, the Brahman in the form of sound (Omkara), manifested. Subsequently, as the very meaning of that sound, the Para-Brahman became renowned and manifest. Therefore, the collection of sacred names such as Śambhu and Śiva, which arose first, should be revered as the father of Lord Śiva. This embodied form of Śiva, who bears the lofty waves of the Gaṅgā and is adorned with serpents, is to be understood as a son to that primordial Śabda-Brahman.

नादो नाभि सखोऽभवत् प्रथमतो पश्चाद् हृदन्तर्गतः |<br/>पश्चात् कण्ठविलुण्ठन स्तत इमे श्री कण्ठ-पित्रदयः ।।<br/>मूर्ताऽमूर्त मिति द्विधा श्रुतमिदं शब्दार्थ रूपञ्च वा |<br/>पुंस्त्री रूपमिति द्विधा तु भवता मग्रेऽभवत् साम्प्रतम् ।।46।।
nādo nābhi sakho'bhavat prathamato paścād hṛdantargataḥ |<br/>paścāt kaṇṭhaviluṇṭhana stata ime śrī kaṇṭha-pitradayaḥ ||<br/>mūrtā'mūrta miti dvidhā śrutamidaṃ śabdārtha rūpañca vā |<br/>puṃstrī rūpamiti dvidhā tu bhavatā magre'bhavat sāmpratam ||46||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

प्रथम-अतः नादः नाभि-सखः अभवत्. पश्चात् हृत्-अन्तर्गतः (अभवत्). पश्चात् कण्ठ-विलुण्ठनः (अभवत्). ततः इमे श्री-कण्ठ-पित्र-आदयः (भवनति). इदं मूर्त-अमूर्तं च वा शब्द-अर्थ-रूपम् इति द्विधा श्रुतम्. साम्प्रतं तु पुं-स्त्री-रूपम् इति द्विधा भवताम् अग्रे अभवत्.

Meaning of Terms
प्रथम-अतः नादः = first, the sound (Nāda)
नाभि-सखः अभवत् = arises from the navel (grandfather)
पश्चात् हृत्-अन्तर्गतः (अभवत्) = then enters the heart (father)
पश्चात् कण्ठ-विलुण्ठनः (अभवत्) = then enters the throat (son)
ततः = therefore
इमे श्री-कण्ठ-पित्र-आदयः (भवनति) = these are the father, grandfather, etc., of Śrīkaṇṭha (Śiva)
इदम् = this Brahman
मूर्त-अमूर्तं च वा शब्द-अर्थ-रूपम् इति = as embodied (Mūrta) and unembodied (Amūrta), and as sound (Śabda) and meaning (Artha)
द्विधा श्रुतम् = is heard to be of two kinds
साम्प्रतं तु = now, however
पुं-स्त्री-रूपम् इति द्विधा = as male and female (Śiva-Pārvatī) in two forms
भवताम् अग्रे अभवत् = has manifested before you
Meaning

The primordial sound, Nāda, first arises from the navel, akin to a grandfather. Subsequently, it enters the heart, like a father, and then proceeds to the throat, like a son. Thus, these stages of Nāda's manifestation are considered the ancestral lineage—the father and grandfather—of Śrīkaṇṭha, Lord Śiva. This Brahman, we have heard, exists in two forms: as embodied (Mūrta) and unembodied (Amūrta), and also as sound (Śabda) and its meaning (Artha). Now, that very Brahman has manifested before you in two forms: as the male and female principles, Śiva and Pārvatī.

Meaning of Terms
तस्मात् = therefore
अस्य करे = into the hand of this Śiva
इदं जलं अर्प्यताम् = let this water of Kanyādāna be offered
गङ्गायाः सलिलं = the water of the Gaṅgā
उद्गम-भुवं त्यक्त्वा = leaving its place of origin
भूमि-अन्तरं यथा एति = just as it flows to another land
(तथा) = similarly (this water, releasing the maiden from her paternal ties)
पत्या एव सम्बन्ध-कृत् (भवति) = establishes a bond solely with the husband
शीर्ष-धृता गङ्गा = the Gaṅgā, held on the head
सत्-नृणां शपथ-आचारान् = the vows and observances made by virtuous people
दृढान् करोति = makes them very firm
अधुना सा अपि = now, even that Gaṅgā
एतेन (शिवेन) धृता = is held by this (Śiva) on his head

Therefore, let this sacred water of Kanyādāna be offered into the hand of Lord Śiva. Just as the waters of the Gaṅgā leave their source and flow to other lands, so too does this offering of water release the maiden from her paternal ties and establish her bond solely with her husband. The Gaṅgā, when held upon the head, makes the vows and observances of virtuous people exceedingly firm. Now, this very Gaṅgā is held by Lord Śiva upon his head. Hence, this sacred act of Pāṇigrahaṇa, the taking of the hand, signifies an exceptionally firm and unbreakable marital bond.

अयं ब्राह्म-विवाह-पद्धतिः = this Brāhma marriage ritual
संपूर्यतां, त्वर्यताम् = let it be completed quickly

शम्भवे वारिणि दत्ते (सति) = when the water of Kanyādāna was offered into Śambhu's hand
अग्रतः-सर्पिणा फण-भृता = the serpent, bearing a hood, that was on his hand, moved forward

In this manner, let this Brāhma marriage ritual be completed swiftly. Discussions on the profound meanings of the scriptures should be reserved for another time, not at the very site where the sacred rite is being performed. As the water of Kanyādāna was poured into Lord Śambhu's hand, the serpent, adorned with its hood, which was upon His hand, moved forward and drank that water. Consequently, that sacred water, which bestows honor upon Gaurī, did not fall to the ground from the hand of the Lord.

itthaṃ yatsahacāriṇo'pi vidadhuḥ śambhoḥsahāyakriyām ।<br/>sva svā''dānaphalaṃ śubhaṃ girisutāyai darśayanto mudā ।।<br/>yenāgre śivasannidhe rgirisutā niṣkāsayen no vṛthā ।<br/>sarvebibhyati bhāvino navatamāt strīśāsanāt sevakāḥ ॥49॥
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

इत्थम् | यत् | सहचारिणः | अपि | विदधुः | शम्भोः | सहाय-क्रियाम् | स्व-स्व-आदान-फलम् | शुभम् | गिरिसुतायै | दर्शयन्तः | मुदा || येन | अग्रे | शिव-सन्निधेः | गिरिसुता | निष्कासयेत् | नो | वृथा | सर्वे | बिभ्यति | भाविनः | नवतमात् | स्त्री-शासनात् | सेवकाः ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

इत्थं सहचारिणः (सर्प-गणादयः) अपि मुदा स्व-स्व-आदान-फलं शुभं गिरिसुतायै दर्शयन्तः यत् शम्भोः सहाय-क्रियां विदधुः. येन अग्रे गिरिसुता शिव-सन्निधेः (तान्) वृथा नो निष्कासयेत्. सर्वे सेवकाः भाविनः नवतमात् स्त्री-शासनात् बिभ्यति (खलु).

Meaning of Terms
इत्थं (itthaṃ) = in this manner, thus
सहचारिणः (sahacāriṇaḥ) = companions, attendants (such as serpents, Gaṇas)
अपि (api) = also, even
मुदा (mudā) = with joy, happily
स्व-स्व-आदान-फलं शुभं (sva-sva-ādāna-phalaṃ śubhaṃ) = the auspicious results of keeping them close
गिरिसुतायै (girisutāyai) = to the daughter of the mountain (Parvati)
दर्शयन्तः (darśayantaḥ) = showing, demonstrating
यत् (yat) = that, which
शम्भोः (śambhoḥ) = of Shiva
सहाय-क्रियां (sahāya-kriyāṃ) = act of assistance, help
विदधुः (vidadhuḥ) = they performed, they rendered
येन (yena) = by which, so that
अग्रे (agre) = in the future, later
गिरिसुता (girisutā) = Parvati, the daughter of the mountain
शिव-सन्निधेः (śiva-sannidheḥ) = from Shiva's presence
तान् (tān) = them (implied)
वृथा (vṛthā) = in vain, without reason
नो (no) = not
निष्कासयेत् (niṣkāsayet) = may she expel, may she remove
सर्वे (sarve) = all
सेवकाः (sevakāḥ) = servants, attendants
भाविनः (bhāvinaḥ) = future, impending
नवतमात् (navatamāt) = from the newest
स्त्री-शासनात् (strī-śāsanāt) = from the rule of a woman, from the female governance
बिभ्यति (bibhyati) = they fear
खलु (khalu) = indeed, certainly (implied)
Meaning

In this manner, even the companions of Shiva, such as the serpents and the Gaṇas, joyfully rendered assistance to Shiva, demonstrating to the daughter of the mountain, Parvati, the auspicious benefits of keeping them close. They did this so that in the future, Parvati might not causelessly expel them from Shiva's presence. For indeed, all servants naturally fear the impending rule of a new mistress. This verse playfully illustrates the human-like anxieties of even divine attendants, highlighting their desire to secure their position under the new divine consort, Parvati, by proving their utility and loyalty to Lord Shiva.

title: Ashmarohana & Lajahomam
html:
Ashmarohana & Lajahomam

The bride and groom stepping on the grinding stone and performing Lajahomam with parched grains.

अश्मा रोहणतो बभाण भगवा नश्मेव मे स्याः स्थिरा
गार्हस्र्योत्तमहर्म्य शर्मशतदे लायां शिलावदृढा ।।
न स्यास्त्वं हिमखण्डवद्रवमयी स्मेरोऽब्रवीत् शङ्करः
यच्छुत्वोभयपक्षगाःसमहसन् दृष्ट्वा हिमाद्रेर्मुखम् ।।50।।
gārhasryottamaharmya śarmaśatade lāyāṃ śilāvaddṛḍhā ।।
yacchutvobhayapakṣagāḥsamahasan dṛṣṭvā himādremukham ।।50।।
Ashmā rohaṇato babhāṇa bhagavā naśmeva me syāḥ sthirā
na syāstvaṃ himakhaṇḍavaddravamayī smero'bravīt śaṅkaraḥ
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

अश्म-रोहणतः | बभाण | भगवान् | अश्म | इव | मे | स्याः | स्थिरा | गार्हस्थ्य-उत्तम-हर्म्य | शर्म-शत-दे | लायाम् | शिलावत् | दृढा || न | स्याः | त्वम् | हिम-खण्डवत् | द्रवमयी | स्मेरः | अब्रवीत् | शङ्करः | यत् | श्रुत्वा | उभय-पक्षगाः | समहसन् | दृष्ट्वा | हिम-अद्रेः | मुखम् ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

अश्म-रोहणतः भगवान् बभाण - (त्वं) मे अश्म इव स्थिरा स्याः. शर्म-शत-दे गार्हस्थ्य-उत्तम-हर्म्ये (भूम्यां) शिलावत् दृढा (स्याः). (कानी) त्वं हिम-खण्डवत् द्रवमयी न स्याः (इति) शङ्करः स्मेरः (सन्) अब्रवीत्. यत् श्रुत्वा उभय-पक्षगाः हिम-अद्रेः मुखं दृष्ट्वा समहसन्.

Meaning of Terms
अश्म-रोहणतः = at the time of the Ashmarohana (stepping on the grinding stone) ritual
भगवान् बभाण = Lord Shiva spoke
(त्वं) मे = you, towards me
अश्म इव स्थिरा स्याः = be firm like this stone
शर्म-शत-दे = bestowing hundreds of joys
गार्हस्थ्य-उत्तम-हर्म्ये (लायाम्) = in the excellent mansion of Grihasthashrama (on the ground)
शिलावत् दृढा (स्याः) = be firm like a rock
(कानी) त्वं हिम-खण्डवत् = but you, like a piece of ice
द्रवमयी न स्याः (इति) = may you not be one who melts (fluid)
शङ्करः स्मेरः (सन्) अब्रवीत् = Shankara, smiling, said
यत् श्रुत्वा = hearing which
उभय-पक्षगाः = those from both sides (of the wedding party)
हिम-अद्रेः मुखं दृष्ट्वा = seeing the face of Himavan (the mountain of snow)
समहसन् = laughed together
Meaning

During the Ashmarohana ritual, Lord Shiva spoke, saying, "May you be firm towards me like this stone. May you be as unyielding as a rock on the ground in this excellent mansion of Grihasthashrama, which bestows hundreds of joys. But may you not be one who melts like a piece of ice." Shankara said this with a smile. Hearing this, those from both sides of the wedding party looked at the face of Himavan, the father of Parvati, and laughed together.

Laja-Homa-Vidhih - The ritual of Lajahoma.

लाजा-होमविधिं चकार गिरिजा शम्भुः शुशुम्भतया
श्वैत्यौघः सुहरिद्रयेव मिलितुं चक्रे मनोमोदकान ||
अश्मारोहविधौ पदं प्रति नमन भातिस्म किञ्चिद् धसन
हंसः शोणसरोजचुम्बनमना श्चञ्चुश्रिया पाणिना ||
Lājā-homavidhiṃ cakāra girijā śambhuḥ śuśumbhatayā
śvaityaughaḥ suharidrayeva milituṃ cakre manomodakān ||
aśmārohavidhau padaṃ prati naman bhātisma kiñcid dhasan
haṃsaḥ śoṇasarojacumbanamanā ścañcuśriyā pāṇinā ||
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

लाजा-होम-विधिम् | चकार | गिरिजा | शम्भुः | शुशुम्भ | तया |

श्वैत्य-ओघः | सुहरिद्रया | इव | मिलितुम् | चक्रे | मनः-मोदकान ||

अश्म-आरोह-विधौ | पदम् | प्रति | नमन | भाति | स्म | किञ्चित् | हसन् |

हंसः | शोण-सरोज-चुम्बन-मनाः | चञ्चु-श्रिया | पाणिना ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

गिरिजा लाजा-होम-विधिं चकार. शम्भुः तया (सह) शुशुम्भ. (यथा) श्वैत्य-ओघः सुहरिद्रया इव मिलितुम् मनः-मोदकान चक्रे. अश्म-आरोह-विधौ किञ्चित् हसन् पदम् प्रति नमन (शिवः) पाणिना चञ्चु-श्रिया शोण-सरोज-चुम्बन-मनाः हंसः इव भाति स्म.

Meaning of Terms
गिरिजा = Parvati, the daughter of the mountain king
लाजा-होम-विधिम् = the ritual of Lajahoma (offering parched grains)
चकार = performed
शम्भुः = Lord Shiva
तया = with her
शुशुम्भ = shone brightly
श्वैत्य-ओघः = the mass of white (referring to Shiva)
सुहरिद्रया इव = as if with beautiful turmeric (referring to Parvati, adorned with turmeric)
मिलितुम् = to unite
मनः-मोदकान = sweet thoughts (or joys) in the mind
चक्रे इव = as if he made
अश्म-आरोह-विधौ = in the ritual of Ashmarohana (stepping on the grinding stone)
किञ्चित् हसन् = smiling slightly
पदम् प्रति नमन = bowing towards her foot
पाणिना = with his hand
चञ्चु-श्रिया = with the beauty of a beak
शोण-सरोज-चुम्बन-मनाः = having a mind desirous of kissing a red lotus
हंसः इव = like a swan
भाति स्म = shone
Meaning

Girija (Parvati) began performing the Lajahoma ritual. Lord Shiva, accompanying her, shone with great splendor. This scene was as if Shiva, a mass of white, was making sweet thoughts in his mind, eager to unite with the beautiful turmeric-hued Parvati. During the Ashmarohana ritual, Shiva, with a slight smile, bowed towards Parvati's foot and held it with his hand, appearing like a swan with a beautiful beak, eager to kiss a red lotus.

Mainaka's Arrival

मैनाकः स्वसूदानपुण्यसमये लाजाऽर्पणायऽऽगतः
दुर्भीर्भातिं परिवर्ज्य शौर्यबलतः पौरन्दरीं दूरतः ||
सिन्धो र्हिन्दुरिवोद्गतः प्रतिबभौ इत्युक्तिं सत्यीकरः
ऐदानीन्तन हिन्दुविज्ञविदितां योऽसीसधत् हिन्दुताम् ||
Mainākaḥ svasūdānapuṇyasamaye lājā'rpaṇāyā''gataḥ
durbhīrbhātiṃ parivarjya śauryabalataḥ paurandarīṃ dūrataḥ ||
sindho rhindurivodgataḥ pratibabhau ityuktiṃ satyīkaraḥ
aidānīntana hinduvijñaviditāṃ yo'sīsadhāt hindutām ||
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

मैनाकः | स्वसू-दान-पुण्य-समये | लाजा-अर्पणाय | आगतः | दुर्भीर्भतिम् | परिवर्ज्य | शौर्य-बलतः | पौरन्दरीम् | दूरतः || सिन्धोः | हिन्दुः | इव | उद्गतः | प्रतिबभौ | इति | उक्तिम् | सत्यीकरः | ऐदानीन्तन-हिन्दु-विज्ञ-विदिताम् | यः | असीसधत् | हिन्दुताम् ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

मैनाकः पौरन्दरीं दुर्भीर्भतिम् शौर्य-बलतः दूरतः परिवर्ज्य स्वसू-दान-पुण्य-समये लाजा-अर्पणाय आगतः. यः (मैनाकः) ऐदानीन्तन-हिन्दु-विज्ञ-विदिताम् उक्तिं सत्यीकरः सिन्धोः हिन्दुः इव उद्गतः प्रतिबभौ, (तथा) हिन्दुताम् असीसधत्.

Meaning of Terms
मैनाकः = Mount Mainaka
स्वसू-दान-पुण्य-समये = at the auspicious time of giving away his sister (Parvati)
लाजा-अर्पणाय = to offer parched grains
आगतः = arrived
पौरन्दरीम् = related to Indra
दुर्भीर्भतिम् = terrifying fear
शौर्य-बलतः = by the strength of his valor
दूरतः परिवर्ज्य = having cast away far off
यः = who (Mainaka)
सिन्धोः = from the Sindhu ocean (or river)
हिन्दुः इव उद्गतः = emerged like a Hindu
प्रतिबभौ = shone forth
इति उक्तिम् सत्यीकरः = making this statement true
ऐदानीन्तन-हिन्दु-विज्ञ-विदिताम् = known to modern Hindu scholars (the argument that Hindus originated from the Sindhu river)
हिन्दुताम् असीसधत् = established his Hindutva (Hindu identity)
Meaning

Mount Mainaka arrived to offer parched grains at the auspicious time of giving away his sister (Parvati), having cast away the terrifying fear caused by Indra far off through the strength of his valor. Mainaka, who emerged like a Hindu from the Sindhu ocean (or river), shone forth, thereby making true the statement known to modern Hindu scholars that Hindus originated from the Sindhu river, and thus established his Hindu identity.

'ला जा' शम्भुगृहात् स्वसः ! सितयशः श्वेताट्टहासप्रभम्
आनैवम् च यथाहा मब्धितलतो हिन्दीं गिरं भाविनीम् ||
सेयंवाङ् मिलितास्तु संस्कृतवचोरूपेण ते शम्भुना
त्वद्वत् स्तान् मधुरो द्वयोरपि गिरोर्ग्रन्थिरृढोऽग्रे सरः ||
'Lā jā' śambhugṛhāt svasaḥ ! sitayaśaḥ śvetāṭṭahāsaprabham
ānaivaṃ ca yathāha mabdhitālato hindīṃ giraṃ bhāvinīm ||
seyavāṅ militāstu saṃskṛtavacorūpeṇa te śambhunā
tvadvat stān madhuro dvayorapi girorgranthirdṛḍho'gre saraḥ ||
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

'ला जा' | शम्भु-गृहात् | स्वसः ! | सित-यशः | श्वेता-अट्टहास-प्रभम् | आनय | एवम् | च | यथा | अहम् | अब्धि-तलतः | हिन्दीम् | गिरम् | भाविनीम् || सा | इयम् | वाक् | मिलिता | अस्तु | संस्कृत-वचः-रूपेण | ते | शम्भुना | त्वत्-वत् | स्तात् | मधुरः | द्वयोः | अपि | गिरोः | ग्रन्थिः | दृढः | अग्रे | सरः ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

स्वसः ! श्वेता-अट्टहास-प्रभं सित-यशः शम्भु-गृहात् 'ला जा' (आनय). यथा अहम् भाविनीं हिन्दीम् गिरम् अब्धि-तलतः आनयम् एवम् च. सा इयम् वाक् ते संस्कृत-वचः-रूपेण शम्भुना मिलिता अस्तु. त्वत्-वत् द्वयोः अपि गिरोः मधुरः दृढः अग्रे सरः ग्रन्थिः स्तात्.

Meaning of Terms
स्वसः ! = O Sister!
श्वेता-अट्टहास-प्रभम् = shining like the radiance of white laughter
सित-यशः = pure fame
शम्भु-गृहात् = from Shiva's abode
'ला जा' (आनय) = go and bring ('lājā' means parched grains, or 'bring')
यथा अहम् = just as I
भाविनीम् हिन्दीम् गिरम् = the future Hindi language
अब्धि-तलतः = from the bottom of the ocean
आनयम् = brought
एवम् च = and similarly (may you also bring fame)
सा इयम् वाक् = that this speech (Hindi language)
ते शम्भुना = with your Shiva
संस्कृत-वचः-रूपेण = in the form of Sanskrit speech
मिलिता अस्तु = may it be united
त्वत्-वत् = like your (marital) bond
द्वयोः अपि गिरोः = between both languages (Sanskrit and Hindi)
मधुरः दृढः = sweet and firm
अग्रे सरः ग्रन्थिः स्तात् = may a progressive bond (knot) be formed in the future
Meaning

O Sister! Go and bring pure fame from Shiva's abode, shining like the radiance of white laughter. Just as I brought forth the future Hindi language from the depths of the ocean, so too may you bring this fame. May this speech (Hindi language) be united with your Shiva, who embodies the form of Sanskrit speech. And like your marital bond, may a sweet, firm, and progressive bond be formed between these two languages (Sanskrit and Hindi) in the future.

लाजाः श्वेततमा धनञ्जयरदाऽऽकाराश्च भारात्पराः ।
मन्येवीक्ष्य शिवेशिवां युतिमितं वैश्वानरोऽपि स्मितः ॥
त्वद्दत्ता हसिति र्यथैषु निहिता तल्लाघवञ्चात्र वा ।
भूयास्तां वरकन्ययोः सकलयो रित्यग्नितः प्रार्थ्यते ॥
lājāḥ śvetatamā dhanañjayaradā''kārāśca bhārātparāḥ ।
manyevīkṣya śiveśivāṃ yutimitāṃ vaiśvānaro'pi smitaḥ ॥
tvaddattā hasiti ryathaiṣu nihitā tallāghavañcātra vā ।
bhūyāstāṃ varakanyayoḥ sakalayo rityagnitaḥ prārthyate ॥
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

लाजाः | श्वेततमाः | धनञ्जय-रदा-आकाराः | च | भारात्-पराः | मन्ये | वीक्ष्य | शिवे | शिवाम् | युतिमिताम् | वैश्वानरः | अपि | स्मितः || त्वत्-दत्ता | हसितिः | यथा | एषु | निहिता | तत्-लाघवम् | च | अत्र | वा | भूयास्ताम् | वर-कन्ययोः | सकलयोः | इति | अग्नितः | प्रार्थ्यते ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

लाजाः श्वेततमाः धनञ्जय-रदा-आकाराः भारात्-पराः च. मन्ये शिवे शिवां युतिमितां वीक्ष्य वैश्वानरः अपि स्मितः. त्वत्-दत्ता हसितिः यथा एषु निहिता अत्र तत्-लाघवं च वा. सकलयोः वर-कन्ययोः (ते) भूयास्ताम् इति अग्नितः प्रार्थ्यते.

Meaning of Terms
लाजाः = These parched grains (lājāḥ)
श्वेततमाः = are exceedingly white
धनञ्जय-रदा-आकाराः च = and are in the shape of the teeth of Agni Deva (Dhanañjaya, the fire-god)
भारात्-पराः = are without weight (very light)
मन्ये = I think (I believe)
शिवे शिवां युतिमिताम् = the union of Shiva and Parvati
वीक्ष्य = having seen
वैश्वानरः अपि स्मितः = Agni Deva himself might have smiled
त्वत्-दत्ता हसितिः = the smile bestowed by you (by Agni)
यथा एषु निहिता = just as it is placed in these lājāḥ
तत्-लाघवम् च वा = and that lightness is also present here
सकलयोः वर-कन्ययोः = in all brides and grooms
भूयास्ताम् = may they (that smile and lightness) be present
इति अग्नितः प्रार्थ्यते = thus it is prayed to Agni Deva
Meaning

These parched grains (lājāḥ) are exceedingly white, shaped like the teeth of Agni Deva, and are remarkably light. It seems as though Agni Deva himself might have smiled upon witnessing the auspicious union of Shiva and Parvati. O Agni Deva, just as the smile and lightness bestowed by you are present in these lājāḥ, may such a smile and joyful lightness be present in all brides and grooms. Thus, this prayer is offered to Agni Deva.

मैनाकेन तुतोष चेतसि तुराषाट् कोषमाप्तः पुरा ।
देवाः सत् कृति-दर्शनाद् विजहते पूर्वापराधान् नृणाम् ॥
पाथोधौ स गतः पुनर्द्रुततरं पुत्रीकृतस्तेन यत् ।
अङ्काऽऽवासकरश्चिरं सुतसमः सर्वोजनो जायते ॥
mainākena tutoṣa cetasi turāṣāṭ koṣamāptaḥ purā ।
devāḥ sat kṛti-darśanād vijahate pūrvāparādhān nṛṇām ॥
pāthodhau sa gataḥ punardrutataraṃ putrīkṛtasteṇa yat ।
aṅkā''vāsakaraściraṃ sutasamaḥ sarvojano jāyate ॥
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

मैनाकेण | तुतोष | चेतसि | तुराषाट् | कोषम् | आप्तः | पुरा | देवाः | सत्-कृति-दर्शनात् | विजहते | पूर्व-अपराधान् | नृणाम् || पाथोधौ | सः | पुनः | द्रुततरम् | पुत्रीकृतः | तेन | यत् | अङ्क-आवास-करः | चिरम् | सुत-समः | सर्वः | जनः | जायते ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

पुरा कोषम् आप्तः तुराषाट् चेतसि मैनाकेण तुतोष. देवाः सत्-कृति-दर्शनात् नृणां पूर्व-अपराधान् विजहते. सः पुनः द्रुततरं पाथोधौ गतः यत् तेन पुत्रीकृतः. चिरम् अङ्क-आवास-करः सर्वः जनः सुत-समः जायते.

Meaning of Terms
पुरा कोषम् आप्तः = Indra, who had previously been angered
तुराषाट् = Indra
चेतसि = in his mind
मैनाकेन तुतोष = was pleased by Mainaka (due to Mainaka's action)
देवाः = the Devas (divine beings)
सत्-कृति-दर्शनात् = upon seeing a good deed (a virtuous act)
नृणाम् पूर्व-अपराधान् = the past transgressions (faults) of humans
विजहते = they abandon (they forget)
सः पुनः द्रुततरम् = he (Mainaka) again very swiftly
पाथोधौ गतः = went into the ocean
यत् तेन पुत्रीकृतः = because he was adopted as a son by that ocean
चिरम् अङ्क-आवास-करः = one who resides in the lap for a long time
सर्वः जनः सुत-समः जायते = any person becomes equal to a son
Meaning

Indra, who was previously filled with wrath towards Mainaka, was now pleased in his heart by Mainaka's virtuous act. Indeed, the Devas, upon witnessing a good deed, tend to overlook the past transgressions of humans. Thereafter, Mainaka swiftly returned to the ocean, for he had been adopted as a son by the ocean itself. Verily, anyone who resides in one's lap for a long time becomes as dear and cherished as one's own son.

title: Circumambulations of Agni & Saptapadi
html:
Circumambulations of Agni & Saptapadi

The profound spiritual significance of circumambulations around the sacred fire and the Saptapadi (seven steps).

The Fourfold Secret of Agni Parikrama: The secret behind performing four circumambulations around the sacred fire.

चत्वारो व्रत, गेह, वृक्षवसति, त्यागा, मता आश्रमाः ।
तेष्वग्रे गमनं तव त्रिषु शुभं पश्चाद्-भवे मेऽस्ति तत् ॥
इत्युद्बोधयितुं वरो निजवधूं कृत्वा पुरोगामिनीम् ।
अन्त्ये वन्हि-परिक्रमेऽग्रगतिमान् विज्ञापयन् मोदते ॥
catvāro vrata, geha, vṛkṣavasati, tyāgā, matā āśramāḥ ।
teṣvagre gamanaṃ tava triṣu śubhaṃ paścād-bhave me'sti tat ॥
ityudbodhayituṃ varo nijavadhūṃ kṛtvā purogāminīm ।
antye vanhi-parikrame'gragatimān vijñāpayan modate ॥
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

चत्वारः | व्रत | गेह | वृक्ष-वसति | त्यागाः | मताः | आश्रमाः | तेषु | अग्रे | गमनम् | तव | त्रिषु | शुभम् | पश्चात्-भवे | मे | अस्ति | तत् || इति | उद्बोधयितुम् | वरः | निज-वधूम् | कृत्वा | पुरोगामिनीम् | अन्त्ये | वन्हि-परिक्रमे | अग्रगतिमत् | विज्ञापयन् | मोदते ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

व्रत-गेह-वृक्ष-वसति-त्यागाः चत्वारः आश्रमाः मताः. तेषु त्रिषु तव अग्रे गमनं शुभम्, पश्चात्-भवे तत् मे अस्ति. इति उद्बोधयितुं वरः निज-वधूम् पुरोगामिनीं कृत्वा, अन्त्ये वन्हि-परिक्रमे अग्रगतिमत् विज्ञापयन् मोदते.

Meaning of Terms
व्रत-गेह-वृक्ष-वसति-त्यागाः (vrata-geha-vṛkṣa-vasati-tyāgāḥ) = Brahmacharya (vow), Grihastha (household), Vanaprastha (dwelling in the forest), and Sannyasa (renunciation)
चत्वारः आश्रमाः मताः (catvāraḥ āśramāḥ matāḥ) = are considered the four Ashramas according to the scriptures
तेषु त्रिषु (teṣu triṣu) = among these, in the first three
तव अग्रे गमनम् शुभम् (tava agre gamanam śubham) = your (the wife's) walking ahead is auspicious
पश्चात्-भवे (paścāt-bhave) = in the last one, Sannyasa
तत् मे अस्ति (tat me asti) = that leadership (of walking ahead) belongs to me (the husband)
इति उद्बोधयितुम् (iti udbodhayitum) = thus, to instruct (to make known)
वरः (varaḥ) = the groom
निज-वधूम् पुरोगामिनीम् कृत्वा (nija-vadhūm purogāminīm kṛtvā) = making his bride walk ahead for the first three rounds
अन्त्ये वन्हि-परिक्रमे (antye vanhi-parikrame) = in the final circumambulation of the fire
अग्रगतिमत् (agragatimān) = he himself walking ahead
विज्ञापयन् मोदते (vijñāpayan modate) = conveys this message and rejoices
Meaning

The scriptures delineate four Ashramas: Brahmacharya (student life), Grihastha (householder life), Vanaprastha (forest dweller life), and Sannyasa (renunciate life). In the first three of these, it is auspicious for the wife to lead. However, in the final Ashrama, Sannyasa, the husband is to take the lead. To impart this profound wisdom to his bride, the groom allows her to walk ahead for the first three circumambulations around the sacred fire. In the final circumambulation, he himself walks ahead, thus conveying this message and experiencing great joy.

वेदानां त्रितयी जगत्सुविदिता ब्रह्मेशविष्ण्वात्मिका ।
सृष्टिस्थानलयाः कृता इह च तैः विख्यातिमाप्त्ता श्चिरात् ॥
देवीनां त्रितयी न केन विदितः काली रमा शारदाः ।
तत्-सत्-पन्-नतये त्रिवार मभवत् कन्या वरस्याग्रगा ॥
vedānāṃ tritayī jagatsuviditā brahmeśaviṣṇvātmikā ।
sṛṣṭisthānalayāḥ kṛtā iha ca taiḥ vikhyātimāptā ścirāt ॥
devīnāṃ tritayī na kena viditāḥ kāḷī ramā śāradāḥ ।
tat-sat-pan-nataye trivāra mabhavat kanyā varasyāgragā ॥
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

वेदानाम् | त्रितयी | जगत्सु | विदिता | ब्रह्म-ईश-विष्णु-आत्मिका | सृष्टि-स्थान-लयाः | कृताः | इह | च | तैः | विख्यातिम् | आप्ताः | चिरात् || देवीनाम् | त्रितयी | न | केन | विदितः | काली | रमा | शारदाः | तत्-सत्-पन्-नतये | त्रिवारम् | अभवत् | कन्या | वरस्य | अग्रगा ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

ब्रह्म-ईश-विष्णु-आत्मिका वेदानां त्रितयी जगत्सु विदिता. तैः इह सृष्टि-स्थान-लयाः कृताः, चिरात् विख्यातिं आप्ताः. काली-रमा-शारदाः देवीनां त्रितयी केन न विदितः? तत्-सत्-पन्-नतये कन्या वरस्य त्रिवारम् अग्रगा अभवत्.

Meaning of Terms
ब्रह्म-ईश-विष्णु-आत्मिका (brahma-īśa-viṣṇu-ātmikā) = embodying Brahma, Ishvara (Shiva), and Vishnu
वेदानाम् त्रितयी (vedānām tritayī) = the triad of the Vedas [possible reading: त्रितयी (tritayī) — the triad of deities]
जगत्सु विदिता (jagatsu viditā) = is well-known throughout the worlds
तैः इह (taiḥ iha) = by them, here (in this world)
सृष्टि-स्थान-लयाः कृताः (sṛṣṭi-sthāna-layāḥ kṛtāḥ) = creation, sustenance, and dissolution are performed
चिरात् विख्यातिम् आप्ताः (cirāt vikhyātim āptāḥ) = they have attained fame since ancient times
काली रमा शारदाः (kāḷī ramā śāradāḥ) = Kali, Lakshmi, and Sarasvati
देवीनाम् त्रितयी (devīnām tritayī) = the triad of Goddesses
केन न विदितः (kena na viditaḥ) = by whom are they not known?
तत्-सत्-पन्-नतये (tat-sat-pan-nataye) = for the veneration of their sacred feet [possible reading: तेषां सतां पदानां नतये (teṣāṃ satāṃ padānāṃ nataye) — for the bowing to the feet of those noble ones]
कन्या (kanyā) = the bride
वरस्य त्रिवारम् (varasya trivāram) = three times before the groom
अग्रगा अभवत् (agragā abhavat) = walks ahead
Meaning

The triad of Brahma, Vishnu, and Maheshvara, embodying the essence of the Vedas, is renowned throughout the cosmos. By them, creation, sustenance, and dissolution are perpetually enacted in this world, and they have been celebrated since time immemorial. Similarly, who does not know the divine triad of Goddesses: Kali, Lakshmi, and Sarasvati? It is to offer reverence at the sacred feet of these divine beings that the bride walks ahead of the groom for three circumambulations around the sacred fire.

एकं ब्रह्म बहुप्रभं भवदिह त्वन्मद्वपुः श्रीधरम् ।
स्मर्तव्यञ्च विदेलिंमं च नितराम् यापेलिंमं नो जनुः ॥
इत्थं ज्ञानविशेष वेषमयतां संबोधयन् स्वां वधूम् ।
अन्त्ये स्वे क्रमणेऽग्रगोऽग्निमयजत् प्रोल्लासयन् संसदम् ॥
ekaṃ brahma bahuprabhaṃ bhavadiha tvanmadvapuḥ śrīdharam ।
smartavyañca videliṃmaṃ ca nitarām yāpeliṃmaṃ no januḥ ॥
itthaṃ jñānaviśeṣa veṣamayatāṃ saṃbodhayan svāṃ vadhūm ।
antye sve kramaṇe'grago'gnimayajat prollāsayān saṃsadam ॥
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

एकम् | ब्रह्म | बहु-प्रभम् | भवत् | इह | त्वत्-मत्-वपुः | श्रीधरम् | स्मर्तव्यम् | च | विदेलिंमम् | च | निताम् | यापेलिंमम् | नो | जनुः || इत्थम् | ज्ञान-विशेष-वेषमयतम् | संबोधयन् | स्वाम् | वधूम् | अन्त्ये | स्वे | क्रमणे | अग्रगः | अग्निम् | अयजत् | प्रोल्लासयन् | संसदम् ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

एकं ब्रह्म इह त्वत्-मत्-वपुः श्रीधरं बहु-प्रभं भवत्. (तत्) स्मर्तव्यं च विदेलिंमं च निताम्, जनुः यापेलिंमं नो. इत्थं ज्ञान-विशेष-वेषमयतम् स्वां वधूम् संबोधयन्, अन्त्ये स्वे क्रमणे अग्रगः (शिवः) संसदं प्रोल्लासयन् अग्निम् अयजत्.

Meaning of Terms
एकम् ब्रह्म इह (ekam brahma iha) = the one Brahman, here
त्वत्-मत्-वपुः श्रीधरम् (tvat-mat-vapuḥ śrīdharam) = assuming the forms of 'you' and 'me' (the bride and groom), adorned with splendor
बहु-प्रभम् भवत् (bahu-prabham bhavat) = shines forth in many forms
स्मर्तव्यम् च निताम् (smartavyam ca nitām) = that Brahman should be constantly remembered
विदेलिंमम् च (videliṃmam ca) = and thoroughly understood [possible reading: विदितं (viditaṃ) — known]
जनुः यापेलिंमम् नो (januḥ yāpeliṃmam no) = life should not be wasted [possible reading: यापनीयं न (yāpanīyaṃ na) — not to be spent idly]
इत्थम् (ittham) = in this manner
ज्ञान-विशेष-वेषमयतम् (jñāna-viśeṣa-veṣamayatām) = the nature of this special knowledge (Sannyasa) [possible reading: ज्ञानविशेषवेषमयताम् (jñānaviśeṣaveṣamayatām) — the embodiment of this special knowledge]
स्वाम् वधूम् संबोधयन् (svām vadhūm saṃbodhayan) = instructing his own bride
अन्त्ये स्वे क्रमणे (antye sve kramaṇe) = in his final circumambulation
अग्रगः (agragah) = he, walking ahead
संसदम् प्रोल्लासयन् (saṃsadam prollāsayān) = delighting the assembly
अग्निम् अयजत् (agnim ayajat) = worshipped Agni
Meaning

"The one supreme Brahman, here, manifests in myriad forms, adorning itself with the splendor of 'your' and 'my' bodies. That ultimate Reality must be constantly remembered and thoroughly understood; one's life should not be lived in vain." Thus, instructing his bride in the profound wisdom of Sannyasa, the groom, in his final circumambulation, walked ahead, delighting the entire assembly, and worshipped the sacred Agni.

आयस्स्याप्यधिकारिणी सुदयिता प्राप्तस्य पत्यापिचेत् ।
मन्ये सा त्रिगुणा कृता श्रुतिरवै र्यत्त्रिक्रमेऽग्रेऽभवत् ॥
किन्तु स्याद्व्ययभारभागपि च सा नाना प्रबन्धेरता ।
क्रीडेत् तत् कर दत्ततः सखिजनैर्भर्ता कदाचित् क्वचित् ॥
āyassyāpyadhikāriṇī sudayitā prāptasya patyāpicet ।
manye sā triguṇā kṛtā śrutiravai ryattrikrame'gre'bhavat ॥
kintu syādvyayabhārabhāgapi ca sā nānā prabandheratā ।
krīḍet tat kara dattataḥ sakhijanairbhartā kadācit kvacit ॥
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

आयस्य | अपि | अधिकारिणी | सुदयिता | प्राप्तस्य | पत्या | अपि | चेत् | मन्ये | सा | त्रिगुणा | कृता | श्रुति-रवैः | यत् | त्रि-क्रमे | अग्रे | अभवत् || किन्तु | स्यात् | व्यय-भार-भाक् | अपि | च | सा | नाना-प्रबन्धे | रता | क्रीडेत् | तत्-कर-दत्ततः | सखिजनैः | भर्ता | कदाचित् | क्वचित् ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

पत्या प्राप्तस्य आयस्य अपि सुदयिता अधिकारिणी चेत्. मन्ये श्रुति-रवैः सा त्रिगुणा कृता यत् त्रि-क्रमे अग्रे अभवत्. किन्तु सा व्यय-भार-भाक् अपि स्यात् नाना-प्रबन्धे रता च. भर्ता तत्-कर-दत्ततः सखिजनैः कदाचित् क्वचित् क्रीडेत्.

Meaning of Terms
पत्या प्राप्तस्य आयस्य अपि (patyā prāptasya āyasyā api) = even of the income earned by the husband
सुदयिता अधिकारिणी चेत् (sudayitā adhikāriṇī cet) = the beloved wife is indeed the mistress
मन्ये (manye) = I believe
श्रुति-रवैः (śruti-ravaiḥ) = by the pronouncements of the Vedas
सा त्रिगुणा कृता (sā triguṇā kṛtā) = she has been made three times more entitled
यत् त्रि-क्रमे अग्रे अभवत् (yat tri-krame agre abhavat) = which is why she walks ahead in three circumambulations
किन्तु (kintu) = however
सा व्यय-भार-भाक् अपि स्यात् (sā vyaya-bhāra-bhāk api syāt) = she also bears the burden of expenses
नाना-प्रबन्धे रता च (nānā-prabandhe ratā ca) = and is engaged in various household management tasks
भर्ता (bhartā) = the husband
तत्-कर-दत्ततः (tat-kara-dattataḥ) = with what is given by her hand
सखिजनैः (sakhijanaiḥ) = with friends
कदाचित् क्वचित् क्रीडेत् (kadācit kvacit krīḍet) = may occasionally play somewhere
Meaning

Indeed, the beloved wife is the true mistress even of the income acquired by the husband. I believe that the sacred Vedic pronouncements have endowed her with three times greater authority, which is why she leads in three of the circumambulations. However, with this authority comes the responsibility of bearing the burden of household expenses and diligently managing various domestic affairs. The husband, with the modest sum provided by her hand, may occasionally find leisure to enjoy with his friends.

The Most Secret Significance of the Wife's Position on the Left (Vāmāṅgī): The most profound and hidden secret behind placing the wife on the left side.

वाम्यं काम्यतमं स्त्रियाः सु-रसदं पत्युः सुपुण्योद्भवम् ।
आज्ञापालन मस्तु किन्तु तदिदं नो किङ्क रीवत् प्रियम् ॥
बिब्बोकभ्रमरा यदोकसि न चेन्नारी मुखाब्जोद्गताः ।
'ग्रामोफोन' रवाच वृद्धवनितागीता विगीतै व सा ? ॥
vāmyam kāmyatamam striyāḥ su-rasadam patyuḥ supuṇyodbhavam ।
ājñāpālana mastu kintu tadidaṃ no kiṅkarīvat priyam ॥
bibbokabhramarā yadokasi na cennārī mukhābjodgatāḥ ।
'grāmaphona' ravāca vṛddhavanitāgītā vigītaiva sā ? ॥

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

स्त्रियाः वाम्यं काम्यतमं सु-रसदं पत्युः सुपुण्य-उद्भवम्. आज्ञा-पालनं अस्तु किन्तु तत् इदं किङ्क रीवत् नो प्रियम्. यदि ओकसि नारी-मुख-अब्ज-उद्गताः बिब्बोक-भ्रमराः न चेत्. सा 'ग्रामोफोन'-रवाः वृद्ध-वनिता-गिताः च (भवति चेत् तत्) विगिता एव ?

Meaning of Terms
स्त्रियाः वाम्यम् = the 'vāmata' (the nature of playful sulking or slight anger) of a wife
काम्यतमम् = most desirable
सु-रसदम् = gives sweet rasa (essence/flavor)
पत्युः सुपुण्य-उद्भवम् = it arises from the good fortune (Punya) of the husband
आज्ञा-पालनम् अस्तु = her obedience to commands may be present
किन्तु तत् इदम् = but that obedience
किङ्क रीवत् नो प्रियम् = is not pleasing if it is like that of a maidservant (without any retort)
यदि ओकसि = if in the home
नारी-मुख-अब्ज-उद्गताः = emerging from the lotus-face of a woman
बिब्बोक-भ्रमराः न चेत् = if the bees of amorous quarrels (or playful gestures) do not hum
सा = that woman
'ग्रामोफोन'-रवाः = if she sounds like a 'gramophone' record
वृद्ध-वनिता-गिताः च = or like the songs of old women
विगिता एव ? = what joy is there in that? (Is it not discordant?)
Meaning

The playful sulking or slight anger (vāmata) of a wife is most desirable; it bestows a sweet essence, and such good fortune arises from the husband's Punya. While she should obey her husband's commands, if she does so like a mere maidservant, without any playful resistance, it brings no joy. If, in a home, the bees of amorous quarrels (or playful gestures) do not hum forth from the lotus-face of the woman, and she merely speaks like a gramophone record or the monotonous songs of old women, what joy can there be in such a marital relationship? It would indeed be discordant.

वल्लर्यः सुकृतस्य कस्यचिदिमा वामाः स्ववामेस्थिताः ॥
svoṣṭhau suṣṭhutayā dravaiḥ śiśumukhaṃ dugdhai ruroja srutaiḥ ।
kāntān danta karairudanta lasitaiḥ śrāntān gṛhaikāntagān ॥
limpantyaḥ parivartayanti mahilāḥ śīlaṃ śilākarkaśam ।

Meaning of Terms
महिलाः = women
सुष्ठुतया = for beauty
द्रवैः = with some liquids (colors)
स्ोषठौ = their own lips
लिम्पन्त्यः = anointing (applying)
उरोज-स्रुतैः = flowing from their breasts

शिशु-मुखम् = the faces of children (anointing)
श्रान्तान् = those who are tired
गृह-एकान्त-गान् = who have come to the solitude of home
कान्तान् = their husbands
उदन्त-लसितैः = shining with narratives (words)
दन्त-करैः = with the radiance of their teeth
लिम्पन्त्यः = anointing (delighting)
शिला-क र्कशम् = hard as a stone
शीलम् (अपि) = (even) the nature/disposition
परिवर्तयन्ति = they transform
स्व-वामे स्थिताः = seated on their left side

कस्यचित् सुकृतस्य = of someone's good deeds (Punya)
वल्लर्यः = are indeed creepers!
Meaning

Women, anointing their lips for beauty with various liquids (colors), anointing the faces of their children with milk flowing from their breasts, and delighting their husbands who return home tired and seeking solace, with the radiant charm of their teeth shining with pleasant words, are capable of transforming even a disposition as hard as stone. These wives, seated on the left side (vāmāṅga) of their husbands, are indeed like the creepers of someone's accumulated Punya.

संयोगोऽरुचिकारकः प्रतिदिनं तद् विप्रलम्भे रसः ।
माधुर्य लवणो यथा प्रियतमस्तस्मश्च माधुर्यकम् ॥
तस्माद् वाम्यविधिः कदापि ललनायाः मोदकृत् मन्यते ।
वै रसस्य विनाशकृत् नवनवाऽनन्दस्य वैशेश्यकृत् ॥
saṃyogo'rucikārakaḥ pratidinaṃ tad vipralambhe rasaḥ ।
mādhurya lavaṇo yathā priyatamastasmaśca mādhurya kam ॥
tasmād vāmyavidhiḥ kadāpi lalanāyāḥ modakṛt manyate ।
vairasyasya vināśakṛt navanavā'nandasya vaiśeṣyakṛt ॥

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

Meaning of Terms
प्रति-दिनम् = constantly (every day)
संयोगः = union/cohabitation
अरुचि-कारकः = causes disinterest (boredom)
तत् = therefore
विप्रलम्भे = in separation
रसः (वर्तते) = there is sweet essence
यथा = just as
माधुर्य = after sweetness
लवणः = salt
प्रियतमः = becomes most pleasing
तस्मिन् च = and after that salt

तस्मात् = therefore
ललनयाः = of a woman
वाम्य-विधिः = the practice of vāmata (playful sulking, contrariness)
कदापि = sometimes
मोद-कृत् = causes joy
मन्यते = is considered
(सः) = that playful sulking
वै रसस्य विनाश-कृत् = is the destroyer of tastelessness (boredom)
नव-नव-आनन्दस्य = of new and fresh joy
वैशेश्य-कृत् = is the enhancer of specialness
Meaning

Constant union can lead to disinterest, and thus, even in separation, there is a certain sweet essence. Just as after tasting sweetness, salt becomes most pleasing, and after salt, sweetness again becomes delightful, similarly, the occasional display of 'vāmata' (playful sulking or contrariness) by a woman is considered to bring joy. This playful sulking destroys the tastelessness or boredom in a relationship and enhances the specialness of ever-new and fresh Ananda.

nityāntaḥ sukha eva magna manase dātuṃ navīnaṃ sukham ।
vāmākhyāviditasya sā giri sutā vāmyāya vāme'bhavat ॥
evaṃ lokasamastarītirasavān śrī śaṅkarākhyo varaḥ ।

Meaning of Terms
नित्य-अन्तः-सुखे एव = always in the inner Atmananda (bliss of the Self)
मग्न-मनसे = whose mind is immersed
वाम-आख्या-विदितस्य = known by the name Vamadeva (Lord Shiva)
नवीनम् सुखम् दातुम् = to bestow a new kind of joy
सा गिरि-सुता = that daughter of the mountain king (Parvati)
वाम्यय = to display her vāmata (playful sulking/amorous quarrel)
वामे अभवत् = became seated on the left side (vāmāṅga)
एवम् = in this manner
लोक-समस्त-रीति-रसवान् = who comprehends the essence of all worldly ways
श्री-शङ्कर-आख्यः वरः = the groom named Shri Shankara

Meaning

To bestow a new kind of joy upon Lord Shiva, whose mind is ever immersed in the eternal inner bliss of the Self and who is known by the name Vamadeva, the daughter of the mountain king, Parvati, took her place on His left side (vāmāṅga) to display her vāmata (playful sulking or amorous quarrel). In this manner, Shri Shankara, the groom who comprehends the essence of all worldly ways, and Parvati, the daughter of the mountain, who is the elixir of all various joys, both became worthy of veneration by all people.

यस्यां सप्तपदानि चालयति तां भर्तेश्वरं प्रार्थयन् ।

यज्ञायथा बलाय वित्तनिधये पित्त्यै पशुभ्योपिवा ।

Meaning of Terms
यस्याम् = In which (ritual)
भर्ता = the husband
ईश्वरम् प्रार्थयन् = praying to Ishvara (Lord Vishnu)
ताम् = her (the bride)
सप्त-पदानि चालयति = causes to take seven steps
उपक्रम-करः विष्णुः = Vishnu, the initiator
यज्ञाय = (the first step) for the growth of Yajna (sacred rituals)
अथ बलाय = (the second step) for strength
वित्त-निधये = (the third step) for wealth and grains
पित्त्यै (शरीर औष्ण्यय) = (the fourth step) for bodily health (warmth)
पशुभ्यः अपि वा = (the fifth step) for milk-giving cattle
षट्-संख्य-ऋतु-सुखाय = (the sixth step) for the happiness of the six seasons
सप्तपदता-सख्यस्य लाभाय वा = (the seventh step) for the benefit of friendship gained by walking seven steps together
त्वा अनयतात् = may He lead you (may He cause you to prosper)!
अन्त-अवधि = until the very end
सखे भूयाः = may you be (my) friend!
Meaning

In the ritual where the husband, praying to Ishvara (Lord Vishnu), leads the bride through seven steps, (the mantras from "Viṣṇustvānayatu" to "Sakhe Saptapadā Bhava" are recited). The meaning of these steps is as follows: O Bride! May Vishnu lead you (and cause you to prosper) for the growth of Yajna with the first step, for strength with the second, for wealth and grains with the third, for bodily health with the fourth, for milk-giving cattle with the fifth, for the happiness of the six seasons with the sixth, and for the benefit of friendship gained by walking seven steps together with the seventh. May you be my cherished friend until the very end of our journey.

tātasyāpi gṛhe na yāna mucitaṃ nāhvānakṛt ko'picet |
āhvāne'pi na bhartṛ-vitta-madajodarpaḥ pradarśyaḥ striyā ||
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

यत् | वा | श्रौत-मयैः | पदैः | उपदिशेत् | ताम् | वा | ततः | स्वम् | च | वा | उद्यानम् | न | हितम् | द्वयोः | अपि | कृते | न | उद्यानम् | एकस्य | वा || तातस्य | अपि | गृहे | न | यानम् | उचितम् | न | आह्वान-कृत् | कः | अपि | चेत् | आह्वाने | अपि | न | भर्तृ-वित्त-मद-जः | दपः | प्रदर्श्यः | स्त्रिया ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

यद् वा श्रौत-मयैः पदैः तां (वधूं) वा ततः स्वं च वा उपदिशेत् - द्वयोः अपि कृते उद्यानम् न हितम्, एकस्य उद्यानम् वा न (हितम्). कोऽपि आह्वान-कृत् न चेत् तातस्य अपि गृहे यानम् न उचितम्. आह्वाने अपि स्त्रिया भर्तृ-वित्त-मद-जः दपः न प्रदर्श्यः.

Meaning of Terms
यद् वा = Or (those seven steps)
श्रौत-मयैः पदैः = becoming Vedic statements
ताम् वा = either that bride
ततः स्वम् च वा = or thereafter oneself (the groom)
उपदिशेत् = should instruct in the following manner -
द्वयोः अपि कृते = for both (husband and wife) together
उद्यानम् = wandering in a wrong path (or going to gardens)
न हितम् = is not beneficial
एकस्य उद्यानम् वा न (हितम्) = for one person alone (without company) to wander is also not beneficial
कोऽपि आह्वान-कृत् न चेत् = if no one has invited (without being called)
तातस्य अपि गृहे = even to the father's house (maternal home)
यानम् न उचितम् = going is not proper
आह्वाने अपि = even if invited
स्त्रिया = by the woman
भर्तृ-वित्त-मद-जः दपः = the arrogance born of the husband's wealth
न प्रदर्श्यः = should not be displayed
Meaning

Alternatively, these seven steps, transforming into sacred Vedic pronouncements, offer guidance to both the bride and the groom. They instruct that it is not beneficial for both spouses to wander together on a path of impropriety, nor is it proper for either to wander alone without companionship. Furthermore, a woman should not visit her paternal home without an invitation. Even if invited, she should not display arrogance born of her husband's wealth, for such pride is unbecoming of a virtuous woman.

याच्यो भोजनपानयो रवसरे वस्तृच्चयं नो पतिः ।
मन्तौ भर्तरी दृष्ट गेऽपि बहुशो नित्यं न तं ह्रपयेत् ॥
पत्याचापि न सा सखीषु स-मदं तर्ज्या न गत्यपि वा ।
अर्घ्या सद् वसनैः स-हास-रदनै र्नानाऽशनै र्वाक्-शनैः ॥
yācyo bhojanapānayo ravasare vastṛccayaṃ no patiḥ |
mantau bhartarī dṛṣṭa ge'pi bahuśo nityaṃ na taṃ hrapayet ||
patyācāpi na sā sakhīṣu sa-madaṃ tarjyā na gatyapi vā |
arghyā sad vasanaiḥ sa-hāsa-radanai rnānā'śanai rvāk-śanaiḥ ||
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

याच्यः | भोजन-पानयोः | अवसरे | वस्तु-उच्चयम् | नो | पतिः | मन्तौ | भर्तरी | दृष्टि-गे | अपि | बहुशः | नित्यम् | न | तम् | ह्रपयेत् || पत्या | च | अपि | न | सा | सखीषु | स-मदम् | तर्ज्या | न | गत्य | अपि | वा | अर्घ्या | सत्-वसनैः | स-हास-रदनैः | नाना-अशनैः | वाक्-शनैः ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

भोजन-पानयोः अवसरे पतिः वस्तु-उच्चयम् नो याच्यः. भर्तरी मन्तौ (अपराधे) दृष्टि-गे अपि नित्यम् बहुशः तम् न ह्रपयेत्. पत्या च अपि सा सखीषु स-मदम् न तर्ज्या, न गत्य अपि वा. (सा पत्या) सत्-वसनैः स-हास-रदनैः नाना-अशनैः वाक्-शनैः (च) अर्घ्या.

Meaning of Terms
भोजन-पानयोः अवसरे = at the time of eating and drinking
पतिः = the husband
वस्तु-उच्चयम् = various items
नो याच्यः = should not be asked for
भर्तरी मन्तौ (अपराधे) दृष्टि-गे अपि = even if a fault (offense) is seen in the husband
नित्यम् बहुशः = always repeatedly
तम् न ह्रपयेत् = should not humiliate him (should not make him feel ashamed)
पत्या च अपि = and by the husband also
सा = she (the wife)
सखीषु = among her friends
स-मदम् = with arrogance
न तर्ज्या = should not be threatened
न गत्य अपि वा = nor should she be reviled
(सा पत्या) = (She, by the husband)
सत्-वसनैः = with good garments
स-हास-रदनैः = with words accompanied by a gentle smile
नाना-अशनैः = with various kinds of food
वाक्-शनैः = with soft (gentle) words
अर्घ्या (पूज्या) = should be honored
Meaning

(The instruction from these steps continues thus): A wife should not ask her husband for various items while he is eating or drinking. Even if she perceives a fault in her husband, she should not repeatedly humiliate him or cause him shame. Similarly, the husband should not threaten or revile his wife with arrogance when she is among her friends. Rather, she should be honored by her husband with fine garments, delicious meals, and gentle words accompanied by a loving smile.

इत्थं सप्त महर्षि मान्यवदनात् सद् वाक्यमुक्तावळीम् ।
साऽधार्षीत् श्रवसोः शिवोऽपि गुरुराट् स्वीयोपयोग्याददे ॥
गृह्णन्त्येव च बालकादपि वचो हृद्यं महान्तो जनाः ।
बालाश्चापि पितॄन्नधीतसदृशं संश्रावयनतेतमाम् ॥
itthaṃ sapta maharṣi mānyavadanāt sad vākyamuktāvaḷīm |
sā'dhārṣīt śravasoḥ śivo'pi gururāṭ svīyopayogyādade ||
gṛhṇantyeva ca bālakādapi vaco hṛdyaṃ mahānto janāḥ |
bālāścāpi pitṝnnadhītasadṛśaṃ saṃśrāvayanatetamām ||
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

इत्थम् | सप्त | महर्षि-मान्य-वदनात् | सत्-वाक्य-मुक्तावळीम् | सा | अधार्षीत | श्रवसोः | शिवः | अपि | गुरु-राट् | स्वीय-उपयोगी | आददे || गृह्णन्ति | एव | च | बालकात् | अपि | वचः | हृद्यम् | महान्तः | जनाः | बालाः | च | अपि | पितॄन् | अधीत-सदृशम् | संश्रावयनते-तमाम् ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

इत्थम् सा सप्त (पदानि) महर्षि-मान्य-वदनात् सद्-वाक्य-मुक्तावळीम् श्रवसोः अधार्षीत. गुरु-राट् शिवः अपि स्वीय-उपयोगी आददे. महान्तः जनाः बालकात् अपि हृद्यम् वचः गृह्णन्ति एव च. बालाः च अपि पितॄन् अधीत-सदृशम् संश्रावयनते-तमाम्.

Meaning of Terms
इत्थम् = In this manner
सा = that Parvati
सप्त (पदानि) = those seven steps
महर्षि-मान्य-वदनात् = from the revered mouths of the great sages
सत्-वाक्य-मुक्तावळीम् = a string of pearls in the form of good words
श्रवसोः अधार्षीत = wore on her ears
गुरु-राट् शिवः अपि = even Shiva, the king of Gurus
स्वीय-उपयोगी आददे = accepted what was useful for himself
महान्तः जनाः = great people
बालकात् अपि = even from a child
हृद्यम् वचः गृह्णन्ति एव च = indeed accept pleasing words
बालाः च अपि = and children also
पितॄन् = to their fathers and others
अधीत-सदृशम् = like what they have studied (like reciting their lessons)
संश्रावयनते-तमाम् = repeatedly make them listen
Meaning

In this manner, Parvati adorned her ears with this string of pearls, which were the virtuous words emanating from the revered mouths of the great sages, representing the essence of the seven steps. Even Shiva, the sovereign among Gurus, accepted what was beneficial for himself from these teachings. Indeed, great souls accept wholesome words even from a child. Similarly, children too, repeatedly recite what they have learned to their fathers, as if delivering their lessons.

Granthi Bandhanam: The Tying of the Knot

Meaning

The tying of the knot (Granthi Bandhanam).

title: Granthibandhanam & Sindooram
html:
Granthibandhanam & Sindooram

The tying of the bride and groom's garments and the application of Sindoor in the parting of the hair.

जग्रन्थे सितरश्मि रीशवपुषोऽ पर्णाङ्गपीतांशुभिः ।
लक्ष्मी हीरकहारकौस्तुभकरग्रन्थि र्यतो लज्जितः ॥
तत्र श्वेतविभो भयो रिह पुनः श्वेता च पीता च भा ।
वासन्तोत्सव शारदोत्सव युग ग्रन्थि स्मृता वानयत् ॥
jagranthe sitaraśmi rīśavapuṣo' parṇāṅgapītāṃśubhiḥ |
lakṣmī hīrakahārakautubhakaragranthi ryato lajjitaḥ ||
tatra śvetavibho bhayo riha punaḥ śvetā ca pītā ca bhā |
vāsantotsava śāradotsava yuga granthi smṛtā vānayat ||
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

जग्रन्थे | सित-रश्मिः | ईश-वपुषः | अपर्णा-अङ्ग-पीत-अंशुभिः | लक्ष्मी-हीरक-हार-कौस्तुभ-कर-ग्रन्थिः | यतः | लज्जितः || तत्र | श्वेत-विभा | उभयोः | इह | पुनः | श्वेता | च | पीता | च | भा | वासन्त-उत्सव-शारद-उत्सव-युग-ग्रन्थिः | स्मृतौ | आनयत् ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

ईश-वपुषः सित-रश्मिः अपर्णा-अङ्ग-पीत-अंशुभिः (सह) जग्रन्थे. यतः लक्ष्मी-हीरक-हार-कौस्तुभ-कर-ग्रन्थिः लज्जितः. तत्र उभयोः श्वेत-विभा (आसीत्). इह पुनः श्वेता च पीता च भा (वर्तते), (अतः इयं) वासन्त-उत्सव-शारद-उत्सव-युग-ग्रन्थिः (इति) स्मृतौ आनयत्.

Meaning of Terms
ईश-वपुषः = of Shiva's body
सित-रश्मिः = white ray (light)
अपर्णा-अङ्ग-पीत-अंशुभिः (सह) = with the yellow rays of Parvati Devi's body
जग्रन्थे = was tied (mingled)
यतः = because of which
लक्ष्मी-हीरक-हार-कौस्तुभ-कर-ग्रन्थिः = the knot of the rays from Lakshmi Devi's diamond necklace and Vishnu's Kaustubha gem
लज्जितः = was ashamed (felt diminished before this)
तत्र = there (with Lakshmi and Narayana)
उभयोः = of both (the necklace and the Kaustubha)
श्वेत-विभा (आसीत्) = there was only white radiance
इह पुनः = but here (with Shiva and Parvati)
श्वेता च पीता च भा = white and yellow radiances (mingled)
(अतः इयं) = therefore this (knot)
वासन्त-उत्सव-शारद-उत्सव-युग-ग्रन्थिः = the knot of the pair of Vasantotsava (spring festival, yellow color) and Sharadotsava (autumn festival, white color)
स्मृतौ आनयत् = brought to memory (recalled)
Meaning

The white radiance of Shiva's body intertwined with the yellow radiance of Parvati Devi's form. Seeing this union, the knot of rays from Lakshmi Devi's diamond necklace and Vishnu's Kaustubha gem felt ashamed. This is because, in the case of Lakshmi and Narayana, both emitted a single white radiance. However, here, with Shiva and Parvati, a union of white and yellow radiances occurred. This reminds us of the knot (union) of the colors of Vasantotsava (yellow) and Sharadotsava (white).

एवं तद्वय-मङ्गलाय रचयन्तेऽद्यापि सत्पण्डिताः ।
वस्त्रग्रन्थनसद्विधिं स भगवान् साम्बःस्मृतौ यद् भवेत् ॥
पद्मा पद्ममुखी च पद्मनयनो विष्णुः स्मृतौ स्था द्यथा ।
चेतोग्रन्थनकं त्विदं वरवधू चेलाञ्चलव्याजतः ॥
evaṃ tadvaya-maṅgalāya racayante'dyāpi satpaṇḍitāḥ |
vastragranthanasadvidhiṃ sa bhagavān sāmbhaḥsmṛtau yad bhavet ||
padmā padmamukhī ca padmanayano viṣṇuḥ smṛtau sthā dyathā |
cetogranthanakaṃ tvidaṃ varavadhū celāñcalavyājataḥ ||
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

एवम् | तत्-द्वय-मङ्गलाय | रचयनते | अद्य | अपि | सत्-पण्डिताः | वस्त्र-ग्रन्थन-सत्-विधिम् | सः | भगवान् | स-अम्बः | स्मृतौ | यत् | भवेत् || पद्मा | पद्म-मुखी | च | पद्म-नयनः | विष्णुः | स्मृतौ | स्थात् | यथा | चेतः-ग्रन्थनकम् | तु | इदम् | वर-वधू-चेल-अञ्चल-व्याजतः ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

एवं तत्-द्वय-मङ्गलाय सत्-पण्डिताः अद्य अपि वस्त्र-ग्रन्थन-सत्-विधिं रचयनते. (तेन) यत् स-अम्बः सः भगवान् स्मृतौ भवेत्. यथा पद्म-मुखी पद्मा च पद्म-नयनः विष्णुः (च) स्मृतौ स्थात्. इदं तु वर-वधू-चेल-अञ्चल-व्याजतः चेतः-ग्रन्थनकम् (एव भवति).

Meaning of Terms
एवम् = in this manner
तत्-द्वय-मङ्गलाय = for the auspiciousness (welfare) of that couple
सत्-पण्डिताः = virtuous scholars
अद्य अपि = even today
वस्त्र-ग्रन्थन-सत्-विधिम् = the sacred ritual of tying the garments (the knot of the garment corners)
रचयनते = perform
यत् = so that (by this)
स-अम्बः सः भगवान् = that Lord, accompanied by Jagadamba (Lord Sambashiva)
स्मृतौ भवेत् = remains in memory
यथा = just as
पद्म-मुखी पद्मा च = Lakshmi Devi, whose face is like a lotus, and
पद्म-नयनः विष्णुः (च) = Vishnu, whose eyes are like lotuses, also
स्मृतौ स्थात् = remain in memory
इदं तु = this (Granthibandhanam)
वर-वधू-चेल-अञ्चल-व्याजतः = under the pretext of tying the corners of the bride and groom's garments
चेतः-ग्रन्थनकम् (एव) = is indeed the tying (union) of their two minds
Meaning

With the intention of bringing auspiciousness to the couple, virtuous scholars even today perform this sacred ritual of tying the corners of their garments. By this, Lord Sambashiva, accompanied by Jagadamba, and Lakshmi Devi, whose face is like a lotus, along with Vishnu, whose eyes are like lotuses, remain ever present in their memory. This Granthibandhanam, under the pretext of tying the garments of the bride and groom, is in truth the sacred union of their two minds.

Sīmante Sindūra Samarpaṇam:

सीमनते समराशिवत् स्थिति करः शम्भोः करैर्पितः ।
सिन्दूरःश्रियमाबबर्ष च वधूसौभाग्यरेखाप्रभः ॥
चञ्चत्कुन्तलकुञ्जपुञ्जमिलितौ गुञ्जेन्द्रगोपौ यथा ।
वर्षानन्तरशुक्लवारिदसमात् शम्भोदमभार्पणात् ॥
sīmante samarāśivat sthiti karaḥ śambhoḥ karairpitaḥ |
sindūraḥśriyamābabharṣa ca vadhūsoubhāgyarekhāprabhaḥ ||
cañcatkuntalakuñjapuñjamilitau guñjendragopau yathā |
varṣānantaraśuklavāridasamat śambhoradambhārpaṇāt ||
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

सीमनते | सम-राशि-वत् | स्थिति-करः | शम्भोः | करैः | अर्पितः | सिन्दूरः | श्रियम् | आबबर्ष | च | वधू-सौभाग्य-रेखा-प्रभः || चञ्चत्-कुन्तल-कुञ्ज-पुञ्ज-मिलितौ | गुञ्जा-इन्द्रगोपौ | यथा | वर्षा-अनन्तर-शुक्ल-वारिद-समात् | शम्भोः | अदम्भ-अर्पणात् ||

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

वर्षा-अनन्तर-शुक्ल-वारिद-समात् शम्भोः (करैः) अदम्भ-अर्पणात् करैः अर्पितः वधू-सौभाग्य-रेखा-प्रभः सिन्दूरः सीमनते सम-राशि-वत् स्थिति-करः (सन्) चञ्चत्-कुन्तल-कुञ्ज-पुञ्ज-मिलितौ गुञ्जा-इन्द्रगोपौ यथायं श्रियं आबबर्ष च.

Meaning of Terms
वर्षा-अनन्तर-शुक्ल-वारिद-समात् = like the white cloud that appears after the rain
शम्भोः (करैः) = by the hands of Lord Shiva
अदम्भ-अर्पणात् = due to the sincere (with a smile) offering
अर्पितः करैः = placed by those hands
वधू-सौभाग्य-रेखा-प्रभः = shining like the line of auspiciousness of the bride
सिन्दूरः = the vermillion
सीमनते = in the parting of the hair
सम-राशि-वत् = like a heap
स्थिति-करः (सन्) = having become stable
चञ्चत्-कुन्तल-कुञ्ज-पुञ्ज-मिलितौ = mingled within the clusters of groves of swaying locks of hair
गुञ्जा-इन्द्रगोपौ यथायं = like the Gunja berry and the Indragopa insect (scarlet mite)
श्रियम् = splendor
आबबर्ष च = and showered
Meaning

Lord Shiva, pure like the white cloud that appears in the sky after the rain, sincerely and with a smile, placed the Sindoor in Parvati's hair parting. That Sindoor, shining like the line of auspiciousness of the bride, settled like a heap in the hair parting. Mingled within the clusters of groves formed by her swaying dark locks of hair, it showered splendor, resembling the red Gunja berry and the Indragopa insect (scarlet mite).

title: Parvati Devi's Farewell
html:
Parvati Devi's Farewell

Parvati's journey (Prayāṇotsavam) to Kailasa with Shiva on Nandi.

Parvati Prayāṇotsavaḥ (Bidāyi): Parvati Devi's Departure to Her In-laws' Home (Farewell):

श्वश्रूशासनातः परा श्वशुरजान् मुक्ता च संकोचतः ।
दूरे चास्ति ननान्दृनिन्दननदात् वा देवरोपद्रवात् ॥
ऐदानीन्तनसंस्कृतिं प्रति किमासीत् श्री भवान्या रतिः? ।
स्मेराः सर्वसखी विधाय चलिता पत्येकपाणिग्रहा ॥
śvaśrūśāsanataḥ parā śvaśurajān muktā ca saṃkocataḥ |
dūre cāsti nanāndṛnindananadāt vā devaropadravāt ||
aidānīntanasaṃskṛtiṃ prati kimāsīt śrī bhavānyā ratiḥ? |
smerāḥ sarvasakhī vidhāya calitā patyekapāṇigrahā ||
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

श्वश्रूशासनातः | परा | श्वशुरजान् | मुक्ता | च | संकोचतः | दूरे | च | अस्ति | ननान्दृनिन्दननदात् | वा | देवरोपद्रवात् | ऐदानीन्तनसंस्कृतिं | प्रति | किम् | आसीत् | श्रीभवान्याः | रतिः | स्मेराः | सर्वसखी | विधाय | चलिता | पत्येकपाणिग्रहा |

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

श्रीभवान्याः श्वश्रूशासनातः परा, श्वशुरजान् संकोचतः च मुक्ता, ननान्दृनिन्दननदात् वा देवरोपद्रवात् च दूरे अस्ति. पत्येकपाणिग्रहा (सती) सर्वसखीः स्मेराः विधाय चलिता. (अतः) ऐदानीन्तनसंस्कृतिं प्रति रतिः किम् आसीत्?

Meaning of Terms
श्वश्रूशासनातः = (from the commands of the mother-in-law) from the dictates of the mother-in-law (as there was no mother-in-law)
परा = far away
श्वशुरजान् (श्वशुरजात्) = arising from the father-in-law
संकोचतः च = and from shyness (hesitation)
मुक्ता = liberated
दूरे च अस्ति = and is far away
ननान्दृनिन्दननदात् = (from the river-like flow of criticism from sisters-in-law) from the torrent of criticism from sisters-in-law
वा = or
देवरोपद्रवात् = (from the mischief of brothers-in-law) from the harassment/mischief of brothers-in-law
ऐदानीन्तनसंस्कृतिं प्रति = towards the modern culture of today's era
किम् आसीत् = was there, what?
श्रीभवान्याः (मूलमुन 'भदांन्या' अनि मुद्रितमैनदि) = of Sri Parvati Devi [possible reading: श्रीभवान्याः — of Sri Bhavani]
रतिः = affection/fondness
स्मेराः = smiling ones
सर्वसखी (सर्वसखीः) = all the female companions
विधाय = having made
चलिता = departed
पत्येकपाणिग्रहा = (she by whom the single hand of the husband is held) holding the hand of her sole husband, Shiva
Meaning

As Shiva had no parents, Parvati Devi was free from the burden of her mother-in-law's authority. She was also liberated from the shyness and hesitation that one might feel in the presence of a father-in-law. She was far from the torrent of criticism from sisters-in-law and the mischief caused by brothers-in-law. In this manner, holding the hand of her unique husband, Shiva, she departed, making all her companions smile. It appears as if Sri Parvati Devi had developed an affection for the modern culture of today's era (where a couple lives separately, not in a joint family).

लोके भर्तृकरद्वयेन वृषभारोहोऽपि हासास्पदम् ।
एकस्तस्य ककुद्गतो द्रुतिमिवा रोद्धुं च रुद्धः स्वयम् ॥
कालप्तिमती दृढीकृतमना बद्ध्वा कटौ शाटिकाम् ।
आरोढुं प्रचलत्पदापि विहसत्पत्येकपाणिग्रहा ॥
loke bhartṛkaradvayena vṛṣabhāroho'pi hāsāspadam |
ekastasya kakudgato drutimivā roddhuṃ ca ruddhaḥ svayam ||
kālaptimatī dṛḍhīkṛtamanā baddhvā kaṭau śāṭikām |
āroḍhuṃ pracalatpadāpi vihasatpatyekapāṇigrahā ||
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

लोके | भर्तृकरद्वयेन | वृषभआरोहः | अपि | हासास्पदम् | एकः | तस्य | ककुद्गतः | द्रुतिम् | इव | आरोद्धुम् | च | रुद्धः | स्वयम् | कालप्तिमत्ती | दृढीकृतमनाः | बद्ध्वा | कटौ | शाटिकाम् | आरोढुम् | प्रचलत्पदा | अपि | विहसत्पत्येकपाणिग्रहा |

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

लोके भर्तृकरद्वयेन वृषभारोहः अपि हासास्पदम्. तस्य एकः (करः) द्रुतिम् आरोद्धुम् इव ककुद्गतः स्वयम् च रुद्धः. (इति) दृढीकृतमनाः कालप्तिमत्ती कटौ शाटिकां बद्ध्वा आरोढुं प्रचलत्पदा अपि विहसत्पत्येकपाणिग्रहा (विबभौ).

Meaning of Terms
लोके = in the world (in the eyes of people)
भर्तृकरद्वयेन = (by the two hands of the husband) by the husband's two hands
वृषभआरोहः अपि = (ascending the bull) even ascending the bull (Nandi)
हासास्पदम् = (a cause for laughter) becomes a laughing matter
तस्य = of that (Shiva)
एकः = one (hand)
द्रुतिम् इव = as if to stop the speed (the Nandi about to run)
आरोद्धुम् च = and to stop
ककुद्गतः = (gone to the hump) placed on the hump
स्वयम् रुद्धः = itself stopped (engaged)
कालप्तिमत्ती = being quick and agile for that moment
दृढीकृतमनाः = (she whose mind is made firm) having firmed her resolve
कटौ = to the waist
शाटिकाम् बद्ध्वा = having tied the sari tightly
आरोढुम् = to ascend
प्रचलत्पदा अपि = (she whose feet are moving forward) even though her feet were moving forward
विहसत्पत्येकपाणिग्रहा = (she by whom the single hand of the smiling husband is held) holding the single hand of her smiling husband, she shone
Meaning

In the world, for a husband to help his wife ascend a bull (Nandi) by holding her with both hands would be a cause for laughter. Moreover, one of Shiva's hands was already placed on Nandi's hump, as if to restrain its speed, thus being engaged. Considering all this, Parvati, with a resolute mind and the agility appropriate for the moment, tied her sari tightly around her waist. Even as she stepped forward to ascend, she held the single hand of her smiling husband, Shiva, and thus shone with grace.

यः स्वाङ्गच्छटया शिवस्य विभया राकानपेक्षाकरः ।
सोऽद्रिः स्वागतकारिभिर्घनचयाः सम्पादितस्तामसः ॥
जाटाजूटशशाङ्कटार्चमहसा विद्योतमानस्थलः ।
शीघ्रकृतिमती जहास गिरिजा पत्येकपाणिग्रहा ॥
yaḥ svāṅgacchaṭayā śivasya vibhayā rākānapekṣākaraḥ |
so'driḥ svāgatakāribhirghanacayāḥ sampāditastāmasaḥ ||
jāṭājūṭaśaśāṅkaṭārcamahasā vidyotamānasthalaḥ |
śīghrakṛtimatī jahāsa girijā patyekapāṇigrahā ||
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

यः | स्वाङ्गच्छटया | शिवस्य | विभया | राकानपेक्षाकरः | सः | अद्रिः | स्वागतकआरिभिः | घनचयाः | सम्पादितः | तामसः | जाटाजूटशशाङ्कअटार्चमहसा | विद्योतमानस्थलः | शीघ्रकृतिमती | जहास | गिरिजा | पत्येकपाणिग्रहा |

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

यः अद्रिः स्वाङ्गच्छटया शिवस्य विभया (च) राकानपेक्षाकरः, सः स्वागतकआरिभिः घनचयाः तामसः सम्पादितः. (तदा) जाटाजूटशशाङ्कअटार्चमहसा विद्योतमानस्थलः (बभूव). (तदा) शीघ्रकृतिमती गिरिजा पत्येकपाणिग्रहा जहास.

Meaning of Terms
यः अद्रिः = which Kailasa mountain
स्वाङ्गच्छटया = (by the splendor of its own body) by the radiance of its own form, and
शिवस्य विभया = by Shiva's effulgence
राकानपेक्षाकरः = (that which makes the full moon night unnecessary) that which disregards even the moonlight of a full moon night
सः = that mountain
स्वागतकआरिभिः = by the welcoming
घनचयाः = (by masses of clouds) by the clusters of clouds
तामसः = darkened
सम्पादितः = was made
जाटाजूटशशाङ्कअटार्चमहसा = (by the light of the moon in the matted locks, which is like a torch) by the light of the moon in the matted locks, which served as a 'torchlight'
विद्योतमानस्थलः = (having illuminated places) having its places illuminated (that mountain was)
शीघ्रकृतिमती = then, being quick in action
गिरिजा = Parvati Devi
पत्येकपाणिग्रहा = holding the single hand of her husband
जहास = began to laugh
Meaning

The Kailasa mountain, which by its own splendor and Shiva's effulgence, disregards even the moonlight of a full moon night, was made dark by the welcoming clusters of clouds. At that moment, the places on the mountain began to be illuminated by the light of the moon in Shiva's matted locks, which served as a 'torchlight'. Then, Parvati, moving swiftly, held the single hand of her husband and began to laugh.

श्वेतं स्वामिनमद्रिशृङ्गसिततां श्वेतान् बहून् नन्दिनः ।
श्वेतान् वर्षितपाथसो घनचयान् आलोक्य मन्दस्मिता ॥
भर्तुर्मूर्धशशाङ्करश्मिभिरपि श्वेतायमानानना ।
मा भूद्विस्मृतिरत्र नाविति दृढं पत्येकपाणिग्रहा ॥
śvetaṃ svāminamadriśṛṅgasitatāṃ śvetān bahūn nandinaḥ |
śvetān varṣitapāthaso ghanacayān ālokya mandasmitā ||
bharturmūrdhaśaśāṅkaraśmibhirapi śvetāyamānānanā |
mā bhūdvismṛtiratra nāviti dṛḍhaṃ patyekapāṇigrahā ||
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

श्वेतम् | स्वामिनम् | अद्रिशृङ्गसितताम् | श्वेतान् | बहून् | नन्दिनः | श्वेतान् | वर्षितपाथसः | घनचयान् | आलोक्य | मन्दस्मिता | भर्तुः | मूर्धशशाङ्करश्मिभिः | अपि | श्वेतायमानानना | मा | भूत् | विस्मृतिः | अत्र | नौ | इति | दृढम् | पत्येकपाणिग्रहा |

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

श्वेतं स्वामिनम्, अद्रिशृङ्गसितताम्, श्वेतान् बहून् नन्दिनः, वर्षितपाथसः श्वेतान् घनचयान् आलोक्य मन्दस्मिता (सती), भर्तुः मूर्धशशाङ्करश्मिभिः अपि श्वेतायमानानना (सती), अत्र नौ विस्मृतिः मा भूत् इति पत्येकपाणिग्रहा दृढं (जग्राह).

Meaning of Terms
श्वेतम् स्वामिनम् = her Lord, who has a white body
अद्रिशृङ्गसितताम् = the whiteness of the mountain peaks
श्वेतान् बहून् नन्दिनः = many white Nandis (groups of Nandi)
वर्षितपाथसः = having rained water (and thus turned white)
श्वेतान् घनचयान् = white clusters of clouds
आलोक्य = having seen
मन्दस्मिता = having a gentle smile
भर्तुः = of the husband
मूर्धशशाङ्करश्मिभिः अपि = even by the rays of the moon on his head
श्वेतायमानानना = (she whose face is becoming white) having a face that was shining white
अत्र = amidst so many white objects
नौ = we two
विस्मृतिः मा भूत् = may not be forgotten (may not disappear from sight)
इति = thus thinking
पत्येकपाणिग्रहा = holding the single hand of her husband
दृढम् = firmly held
Meaning

Seeing her Lord with a white body, the whiteness of the Kailasa mountain peaks, many white Nandis, and white clusters of clouds that had rained water, Parvati smiled gently. Moreover, her face too began to shine even whiter due to the rays of the moon on her husband's head. As if thinking, "Amidst so many white objects, may we two not disappear from each other's sight (or merge into the whiteness)," she firmly held her husband's single hand.

आयान्ति प्रतिवेशिनीत्यभिमतैः श्वश्रूर्भवन्त्यः स्त्रियः ।
याः कुर्वन्ति वधूं सुशिक्षणमिषाच्छिष्यामिवा व्याकुलाम् ॥
नासन्ना अपि दूरजा अपि न ताः श्वश्रूर्वधूर्वा स्वयम् ।
नित्यानन्दगिरीश्वरेतिपदभृत्प्रत्येकपाणिग्रहा ॥
āyānti prativeśinītyabhimataiḥ śvaśrūrbhavantyaḥ striyaḥ ।
yāḥ kurvanti vadhūṃ suśikṣaṇamiṣācchiṣyāmivā vyākulām ॥
nāsannā api dūrajā api na tāḥ śvaśrūrvadhūrvā svayam ।
nityānandagirīśvaretipadabhṛtpratyekapāṇigrahā ॥
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

आयान्ति | प्रतिवेशिनी | इति | अभिमतेः | श्वश्रूः | भवन्त्यः | स्त्रियः | याः | कुर्वन्ति | वधूम् | सुशिक्षणमिषात् | शिष्याम् | इव | व्याकुलाम् | न | आसन्नाः | अपि | दूरजाः | अपि | न | ताः | श्वश्रूः | वधूः | वा | स्वयम् | नित्यानन्दगिरीश्वरेतिपदभृत्प्रत्येकपाणिग्रहा |

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

प्रतिवेशिनी इति अभिमतेः श्वश्रूः भवन्त्यः स्त्रियः आयान्ति, याः सुशिक्षणमिषात् वधूं शिष्याम् इव व्याकुलां कुर्वन्ति. ताः आसन्नाः न, दूरजाः अपि न, स्वयम् श्वश्रूः वधूः वा (भवति). (सा) नित्यानन्दगिरीश्वरेतिपदभृत्प्रत्येकपाणिग्रहा (विबभौ).

Meaning of Terms
प्रतिवेशिनी इति अभिमतेः = with the sentiment of being a neighbor (with familiarity)
श्वश्रूः भवन्त्यः = acting like a mother-in-law
स्त्रियः आयान्ति = some women come
याः = who
सुशिक्षणमिषात् = under the pretext of imparting good teachings
वधूम् = the new bride
शिष्याम् इव = as if a disciple
व्याकुलाम् कुर्वन्ति = make her distressed
ताः = those neighbors
आसन्नाः न = are not near here
दूरजाः अपि न = nor are they far away
स्वयम् श्वश्रूः वधूः वा = here, she herself is the mother-in-law, and she herself is the bride (there is no other)
नित्यानन्दगिरीश्वरेतिपदभृत्प्रत्येकपाणिग्रहा = holding one hand of her husband, who bears the title of Girīśvara, the embodiment of eternal bliss
Meaning

Some women, with the familiarity of being neighbors, come acting like a mother-in-law, and under the pretext of imparting good teachings, they distress the new bride as if she were a disciple. However, here, those neighbors are neither near nor far. Here, she herself is the mother-in-law, and she herself is the bride, for she holds but one hand of her husband, Girīśvara, the embodiment of eternal bliss. Thus, she has no fear.

नन्द्यानन्दथुथूत्कृतैः परिहरन् लोकानितो वा ततः ।
आकर्षान् गिरिजाञ्चलं चलवलन्नेत्राञ्चलश्रीः शिवः ॥
बद्धेवापि सुमुक्ततामिव मनोमध्ये रसन्ती शिवा ।
तन्यास्तामपरे वधूवरयुगे पाणिग्रहाख्यां मुदम् ॥
nandyānandathuthūtkṛtaiḥ pariharan lokānito vā tataḥ ।
ākarṣān girijāñcalaṃ calavalannetrāñcalaśrīḥ śivaḥ ॥
baddhevāpi sumuktatāmiva manomadhye rasantī śivā ।
tanyāstāmapare vadhūvarayuge pāṇigrahākhyāṃ mudam ॥
पदच्छेदम् (Padacchedam)

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

नन्दि आनन्दथु थूत्कृतैः लोकान् इतः ततः वा परिहरन्, गिरिजाञ्चलम् आकर्षान्, चलवलन् नेत्राञ्चलश्रीः (यस्य सः) शिवः (तथा) बद्धा इव अपि मनोमध्ये सुमुक्तताम् इव रसन्ती शिवा अपरे वधूवरयुगे पाणिग्रहाख्यां मुदम् तन्त्यास्ताम्.

Meaning of Terms
नन्दि = of Nandi
आनन्दथु = filled with joy
थूत्कृतैः = with snorting sounds (with 'thūtkāra' sounds)
लोकान् = the people
इतः ततः वा = hither and thither
परिहरन् = moving aside, clearing
गिरिजाञ्चलम् = Pārvatī's garment-hem
आकर्षान् = pulling
चलवलन् नेत्राञ्चलश्रीः = one whose beauty is in the glances of his moving, trembling eyes (due to shyness)
शिवः = Lord Śiva
बद्धा इव अपि = even though bound as if by the knot of the garment
मनोमध्ये = in her heart
सुमुक्तताम् इव = as if great freedom and joy
रसन्ती = experiencing
शिवा = Goddess Pārvatī
अपरे वधूवरयुगे = in other pairs of brides and grooms
पाणिग्रहाख्याम् मुदम् = the joy named Pāṇigrahaṇa (marriage)
तन्त्यास्ताम् = may they spread
Meaning

May Lord Śiva, who, with Nandi's joyful snorting sounds, moves people hither and thither, pulling Pārvatī's garment-hem, and whose beauty is in the glances of his moving, trembling eyes; and may Goddess Pārvatī, who, though bound as if by the knot of the garment, experiences great freedom and joy within her heart—may these divine beings together spread the joy of Pāṇigrahaṇa (marriage) in other pairs of brides and grooms.

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

तदुत्सवाय अत्र शैले तडिच्छतघ्नीगणतः ध्वनयः बभूवुः. घनाघनाः दिनं निशाय्याम् परिवर्तयन्तः दुन्दुभिंवत् च नेदुः.

Meaning of Terms
तदुत्सवाय = for their marriage celebration
अत्र शैले = on that Kailāsa mountain
तडिच्छतघ्नीगणतः = from the multitude of lightning-cannons (lightning as cannons)
ध्वनयः बभूवुः = sounds (like 'taḍā taḍā') arose
घनाघनाः = dense clouds
दिनम् = the day
निशाय्याम् = into night
परिवर्तयन्तः = transforming
दुन्दुभिंवत् च = and like war-drums
नेदुः = roared (sounded)
Meaning

For their marriage celebration on that Kailāsa mountain, sounds like 'taḍā taḍā' arose from the multitude of lightning, which appeared as cannons. Dense clouds, transforming the day into night, roared like war-drums.

अन्वयः (Anvaya)

उमायाः हृदये सुताशा आसीत्. यतः क्षुपादौ पुत्रधियम् चक्रे. स्त्रीमनसः अभिलाषः स्वपतेः पुरस्तात् क्रीडामिषात् प्रकाशितः स्यात्.

Meaning of Terms
उमायाः हृदये = in Umā's (Pārvatī's) heart
सुताशा आसीत् = the desire to play with a child arose
यतः = because
क्षुप आदौ = in the small plants there
पुत्रधियम् चक्रे = she conceived the idea of them being children
स्त्रीमनसः अभिलाषः = the desires of a woman's heart
स्वपतेः पुरस्तात् = before her own husband
क्रीडामिषात् = under the pretext of play
प्रकाशितः स्यात् = are expressed
Meaning

In the heart of Goddess Pārvatī, the desire to play with a child arose, and thus she began to imagine the small plants around her as her children and played with them. It is common for the desires of a woman's heart to be expressed before her own husband under the pretext of play.
